items.title: 虹堡庫藏股執行率53%、均價51.96元 下半年獲利拚回升
items.title_en: Hongbao Treasury Stock Execution Rate 53%, Average Price NT$51.96, Profit Aims to Recover in H2
paras: 工業電腦廠虹堡(5258-TW)公告，買回庫藏股期間屆滿，斥資4143萬元買回797張庫藏股，買回均價51.96元，相較原定買回1500張，執行率約53%；虹堡下半年受惠訂單動能回升，力拚獲利表現好轉。
虹堡原預定自6月30日至8月29日買回1500張庫藏股，買回區間價格34.2-77.9元，實際執行期間則為7月3日至8月27日。
虹堡說明，為維護全體股東權益及兼顧市場交易機制，此次庫藏股視股價變化及成交量狀況採分批買回策略，故未執行完畢，而根據公司原預定規劃，買回庫藏股將轉讓予員工。
營運展望方面，虹堡先前法說會指出，上半年受到記憶體價格飆漲、客戶下單觀望，營運表現低於預期，但隨著記憶體價格趨穩，下半年訂單動能回升、毛利率也可望改善，全年獲利可望較去年持平甚至略升。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Hongbao (5258-TW) announced that the treasury‑stock repurchase period has ended, spending NT$41.43 million to buy back 797 lots of treasury stock at an average price of NT$51.96 per share, representing an execution rate of about 53% compared with the originally planned 1,500 lots; Hongbao expects order momentum to pick up in the second half of the year and is striving for an improvement in profit performance.
Hongbao originally scheduled to repurchase 1,500 lots of treasury stock from June 30 to August 29, with a price range of NT$34.2–77.9; the actual execution period was July 3 to August 27.

Hongbao explained that to protect the interests of all shareholders and respect market trading mechanisms, the treasury‑stock buy‑back was carried out in batches based on price movements and trading volume, so it was not completed. According to the original plan, the repurchased shares will be transferred to employees.

Regarding operating outlook, Hongbao previously stated at its earnings conference that the first half was hurt by soaring memory‑chip prices and cautious customer ordering, resulting in performance below expectations. With memory prices stabilising, order momentum is expected to recover in the second half and gross margin should improve, allowing full‑year profit to be roughly flat with last year or slightly higher.

items.title: 工總率團赴印簽6項MOU 鏈結電子供應鏈將交流走向實際落地
items.title_en: Industrial Federation Delegation Visits India, Signs Six MOUs; Electronics Supply Chain Links Move Toward Concrete Implementation
paras: 為深化台、印度產業合作，掌握全球供應鏈重組及新興科技發展商機，工總由印度分組召集人、東元(1504-TW)集團董事長利明献率團赴印度班加羅爾展開系列產業交流，並與印度商工總會(FICCI)舉辦的「2026台印產業鏈結高峰論壇」，會中雙方共簽署六項合作備忘錄，也鏈結政府、電子供應鏈、智慧車輛、綠色智慧科技及數位轉型等產業公協會及企業代表合作契機。
工總表示，論壇邀請FICCI主席Siddhartha Agarwal、印度商工部次長Amardeep Singh Bhatia，經濟部次長江文若、印度台北協會會長Ninad S. Deshpande、駐印度代表處及印度台商總會總會長陳木騰共同出席，從政策、產業及企業角度交流台印投資布局與供應鏈發展。
利明献表示，全球供應鏈重組正改變企業海外布局思維，投資海外已不再只是追求成本優勢，而是更加重視供應鏈韌性、市場布局及整體解決方案能力。
利明献也以東元為例，近年持續拓展AI資料中心基礎建設、載具電化、能源服務解決方案等海外市場，並協同國際CSP(雲端服務供應商)客戶發展超大型資料中心整體解決方案，展現台灣企業已由產品出口逐步邁向技術整合、工程服務及策略市場和關鍵客戶的戰略布局。
江文若則指出，台印經貿關係近年持續升溫，去(2025)年雙邊貿易額達125.1億美元，創歷史新高，台商赴印度投資亦持續增加，產業布局更加多元，包括近期臺灣ETC電子收費系統已在印度投入營運，而班加羅爾TIIP園區也成為臺灣企業與印度夥伴深化合作的重要據點，期待雙方進一步深化產業鏈結，建立更具韌性的供應鏈夥伴關係。
陳木騰則表示，隨著台灣電子業加快印度布局，當地能否形成足以支撐企業長期營運的產業環境，將是下一階段臺印合作深化的關鍵。除了投資誘因外，在地供應商能量、技術人才、基礎建設、行政效率及政策穩定性，都將直接影響企業擴大投資的意願。
陳木騰強調，未來若能進一步強化投資保障與產業配套，並促進臺印企業共同投入技術、人才及供應鏈建設，將有助台商由個別企業投資逐步形成產業聚落，為企業長期扎根印度創造更有利的條件。
工總表示，會中共簽署六項合作備忘錄。在電子供應鏈方面，昇頻公司將與印度合作夥伴共同拓展印度電信市場及政府標案，推動工業乙太網路、物聯網通訊設備及智慧解決方案應用。
優勝奈米與Techazar E-cyclers Pvt. Ltd.合作，導入台灣電子廢棄物回收技術，推動資源循環再利用；禾麟數碼與 Green Source合作，將影像控制系統導入印度教育及商務市場，並規劃於印度國家電子學院建置示範場域，拓展台灣智慧教育解決方案。
綠色智慧科技方面，台灣資源循環產業推動協會與印度塑膠協會簽署合作備忘錄，未來將透過技術交流、論壇互訪及研究合作，共享市場資訊與研究成果，共同推動資源循環及永續產業合作；燿釷鋰可生公司與印度The Recycling Company 合作，共同推動電子廢棄物回收專案，除評估建置示範場域外，也將規劃進行設備驗證及人員培訓，期望建立標準化回收流程，促進回收技術落地及循環經濟發展。
泰創工程與印度 Shakti Plastic Industries 將合作聚焦於再生與永續材料，進一步探索其導入綠建築及ESG 工程應用的可行模式，拓展永續材料多元再利用的應用場域。
工總表示，未來將持續透過臺印度產業鏈結平台，串聯雙方政府、產業公協會及企業資源，並依台商投資與在地合作需求加強對接，推動更多合作案由交流走向實際落地。
paras_en: To deepen Taiwan‑India industrial cooperation and capture opportunities from global supply‑chain restructuring and emerging‑technology development, the Industrial Federation, led by its India subgroup head and TECO (1504‑TW) Group chairman Li Ming‑xian, traveled to Bangalore for a series of industry exchanges and co‑hosted the “2026 Taiwan‑India Industrial Chain Summit Forum” with the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI). During the forum the two sides signed six memoranda of understanding, linking governments, electronics supply chains, smart vehicles, green smart technology and digital transformation associations and corporate representatives for cooperation.

The Federation noted that the forum invited FICCI chairman Siddhartha Agarwal, Indian Ministry of Commerce Deputy Secretary Amardeep Singh Bhatia, Taiwan’s Deputy Minister of Economic Affairs Jiang Wen‑ruo, president of the India‑Taipei Association Ninad S. Deshpande, as well as the head of Taiwan’s representative office in India and the president of the Indian Taiwanese Business Association Chen Mu‑teng, all of whom discussed Taiwan‑India investment layouts and supply‑chain development from policy, industry and corporate perspectives.

Li Ming‑xian said that the ongoing reshaping of global supply chains is changing how companies think about overseas deployment; investing abroad is no longer just about cost advantage but increasingly about supply‑chain resilience, market positioning and comprehensive solution capabilities.

He cited TECO as an example, noting that in recent years the company has continuously expanded into overseas markets such as AI data‑center infrastructure, vehicle electrification and energy‑service solutions, and has collaborated with international cloud‑service providers to develop ultra‑large data‑center turnkey solutions, illustrating how Taiwanese firms are shifting from pure product export to technology integration, engineering services and strategic market placement for key customers.

Jiang Wen‑ruo pointed out that Taiwan‑India trade relations have been heating up, with bilateral trade reaching a record US$12.51 billion in 2024, and Taiwanese investment in India continuing to grow and diversify. Recent examples include Taiwan’s ETC electronic toll‑collection system now operating in India and the TIIP park in Bangalore becoming a key hub for deeper Taiwan‑India corporate collaboration. He expressed hope for further strengthening of industrial linkages and building a more resilient supply‑chain partnership.

Chen Mu‑teng said that as Taiwan’s electronics sector accelerates its footprint in India, the ability of the local ecosystem to support long‑term corporate operations will be crucial for the next phase of Taiwan‑India cooperation. Beyond investment incentives, the depth of local suppliers, technical talent, infrastructure, administrative efficiency and policy stability will directly affect companies’ willingness to expand investment.

He emphasized that strengthening investment protection and industrial support, and encouraging Taiwan‑India firms to jointly invest in technology, talent and supply‑chain development, will help Taiwanese investors evolve from isolated company projects to an industrial cluster, creating more favorable conditions for long‑term rooting in India.

The Federation reported that six MOUs were signed at the forum. In the electronics supply‑chain arena, Ascend Frequency Co. will partner with an Indian counterpart to expand into India’s telecom market and government projects, promoting industrial Ethernet, IoT communication equipment and smart‑solution applications.

Uwin Nanotech will cooperate with Techazar E‑cyclers Pvt. Ltd. to introduce Taiwanese e‑waste recycling technology and promote resource circularity; Heli Digital will work with Green Source to bring its imaging control systems to India’s education and business markets and plan a demonstration site at the National Electronics Institute of India, expanding Taiwan’s smart‑education solutions.

In green smart technology, the Taiwan Resource Recycling Industry Promotion Association signed an MOU with the Indian Plastics Association to share market information, conduct technology exchanges, forum visits and joint research, jointly advancing resource recycling and sustainable industry cooperation. Yao‑Lu Lithium Co. will partner with India’s The Recycling Company on e‑waste recycling projects, evaluating demonstration sites, equipment validation and staff training to establish standardized recycling processes and foster circular‑economy development.

Taiwanese Tai‑Chuang Engineering will collaborate with India’s Shakti Plastic Industries on regenerated and sustainable materials, exploring their application in green building and ESG engineering projects and expanding the use cases for diversified sustainable‑material reuse.

The Federation said it will continue to use the Taiwan‑India industrial‑chain platform to connect governments, industry associations and corporate resources on both sides, and will strengthen matchmaking based on Taiwanese investment needs and local cooperation demands, driving more projects from dialogue to concrete implementation.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉外資連4買點讚 穩懋周漲17.69％站上所有均線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Foreign Investors Buy 4 Times in a Row, Wenshao Surges 17.69% to Cross All Moving Averages
paras: 三五族砷化鎵PA放大廠穩懋(3105-TW)受惠於AI基礎建設、光通訊需求強勁，穩懋董事長陳進財表示，穩懋產品組合上，已逐步轉型成功，上周更在外資連4買1.2萬張挹注下，周漲17.69％ 成交量爆增至14.4萬張，股價不僅量增價揚衝上500元大關，周線收紅，也站上所有均線。
穩懋近年在產品逐步轉型下，今(2026)年業績表現也持續加溫，第2季稅後淨利9.77億元、季增83%，較去(2025)年同期轉虧為盈、單季EPS 2.3元，累計今年上半年稅後純益15.1億元、EPS達3.56元，也較去年轉盈。
法人指出，隨著AI大廠輝達(NVDA-US)持續推進矽光子CPO交換器量產，加上低軌衛星及光通訊需求逐步成長，有望為穩懋增添新一波成長動能。
穩懋表示，穩懋近年產品從原本最大宗手機PA放大器代工，公司經過這2、3年的改變，加上AI產品需求旺盛下，穩懋已轉變著重在光通訊、太空通訊、國防及AI基礎建設產品上持續努力，占比已超過手機比例。法人預估，穩懋未來有望隨AI產品暢旺下，持續帶動業績增長。
展望下半年業績，法人表示，穩懋雖從記憶體持續缺貨到供應鏈或終端的售價調漲，為今年手機旺季的整體銷售面帶來不確定性干擾，但公司仍持續聚焦於中高階Android及iOS市場上，並具有原有的代工廠競爭優勢，對高階手機拉貨動能並不悲觀，也持續將GaAs(砷化鎵) pHEMT、GaN(氮化鎵)等技術延伸至低軌衛星、太空通訊等領域布局。
paras_en: Wenshao (3105‑TW), a GaAs PA amplifier manufacturer, benefits from strong demand for AI infrastructure and optical communications. Chairman Chen Jincai said the company’s product mix has gradually transformed successfully. Last week, with four consecutive foreign‑investor purchases of 12,000 lots, the stock rose 17.69% during the week, trading volume surged to 144,000 lots, and the price not only climbed above the 500‑NT$ mark but also closed the week in red while crossing all moving averages.

In recent years, Wenshao’s gradual product transformation has kept its performance heating up. In 2026, the company’s Q2 after‑tax net profit reached 977 million NTD, up 83% from the same period last year, turning a loss into a profit and achieving a quarterly EPS of 2.30 NTD. Cumulative after‑tax profit for the first half of the year was 1.51 billion NTD, with an EPS of 3.56 NTD, also turning a loss into a profit compared with last year.

The analyst noted that as AI giant NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) continues to push silicon photonics CPO switch mass production, and with the growing demand for low‑Earth‑orbit satellites and optical communications, Wenshao is expected to gain a new wave of growth momentum.

Wenshao explained that its product line has shifted from primarily mobile PA amplifiers to focus on optical communications, space communications, defense, and AI infrastructure products, which now account for more than the mobile share. The analyst estimates that with the booming AI product demand, Wenshao’s revenue growth should continue.

Looking ahead to the second half, the analyst said that although continuous memory shortages and price hikes in the supply chain or end‑market have introduced uncertainty to the overall mobile sales during this year’s peak season, the company remains focused on the mid‑to‑high‑end Android and iOS markets. With its existing contract‑manufacturing advantage, the analyst is not pessimistic about high‑end phone demand and continues to extend GaAs pHEMT and GaN technologies into low‑Earth‑orbit satellite and space‑communication fields.

items.title: A記憶體價格超越一顆頂級SoC！Gartner上修2026年營收至8373億美元、占半導體市場54%
paras: 人工智慧（AI）浪潮正重新改寫半導體產業的供需結構，過去高度仰賴景氣循環、價格波動劇烈的記憶體市場，如今因高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求爆發，以及大型雲端服務商提前鎖定產能，逐漸從傳統「商品型」半導體轉變為AI基礎建設的核心環節。
Gartner 4月預估，全球記憶體營收將從2025年的2163億美元，大增至2026年的6333億美元，占整體1.32兆美元半導體市場約48%。
到了8月，Gartner進一步上修預測，預估2026年記憶體營收將達8373億美元，占整體1.56兆美元半導體市場比重更攀升至54%。
換言之，記憶體在半導體產業中的地位已大幅提升，AI帶動的HBM需求成為這波市場重估的重要推力。

AI需求爆發　科技巨頭提前多年鎖定記憶體

AI對記憶體需求的影響，不僅反映在市場預測，也直接體現在晶片業者的採購行為。
輝達(NVDA-US) 單季供應鏈與產能預付承諾，就從1190億美元大幅增加至2790億美元。該公司表示，這些承諾主要與記憶體有關，其中920億美元預計在2027會計年度剩餘期間支付，870億美元將於2028會計年度支付，另有880億美元安排在2029會計年度支付。
對記憶體製造商而言，這代表未來數年的需求能見度明顯提高。
目前市場主要由美光科技(MU-US) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 與三星電子(005930KS) 三大業者主導。
SK海力士已與約10家客戶簽訂長期協議；美光則表示，16份策略客戶協議涵蓋合約期間約20%的DRAM產能及約三分之一的NAND產能；三星也已與主要客戶達成多年期記憶體供應協議。
長約有助於記憶體業者降低需求的不確定性，但這並不代表記憶體產業已徹底擺脫景氣循環。

記憶體仍逃不過價格循環　供給增加可能再度反轉

記憶體營收高度受到價格影響，這也是投資人不能忽略的風險。
2018年，記憶體占整體半導體營收比重一度達約34%，但隔年記憶體營收便大減31.5%，其中DRAM平均售價（ASP）暴跌47.4%，記憶體占半導體產業的比重也降至26.7%。
Gartner當時將市場崩跌歸因於產能過剩及價格下滑。這代表記憶體市場即使實際需求沒有大幅萎縮，只要供給增加導致價格下跌，產業營收與獲利仍可能迅速受到衝擊。
長期供應協議確實能鎖定部分採購量，有些合約也包含價格安排，但並不能完全隔絕標準DRAM與NAND受到新產能、庫存及價格競爭的影響。
另一方面，產能擴張也正在進行。SK海力士計畫投資40億美元，在美國印第安納州興建下一代HBM封裝廠；同時，公司已核准截至2031年合計54.3兆韓元（約383億美元）的投資計畫。
技術發展則是另一項變數。SK海力士與SanDisk已推出高頻寬快閃記憶體（High Bandwidth Flash，HBF）標準，目標是緩解AI運算所面臨的記憶體瓶頸。
若相關架構進一步發展，也可能讓部分原本高度依賴HBM的AI工作負載轉向快閃記憶體。

手機記憶體成本暴增　甚至超越旗艦SoC

AI需求同樣正在影響消費電子產品的記憶體成本。
根據微博爆料帳號「數碼閒聊站」的估計，DRAM與NAND的組合成本近期大幅上升，漲幅達340%，甚至已超過部分頂級SoC的價格。
該帳號指出，去年手機廠商採用12GB RAM搭配256GB NAND時，相關成本約70美元；到了2026年第3季，同樣的12GB＋256GB組合，成本已升至約310美元。
相較之下，頂級手機SoC目前價格約280美元。也就是說，記憶體與儲存裝置的成本已成為手機物料清單中極為昂貴的項目。
若手機廠商進一步採用16GB＋256GB或16GB＋512GB等更高容量配置，成本壓力還會進一步增加，可能迫使業者調整產品定價與規格。
「數碼閒聊站」也指出，頂級SoC雖然同樣面臨價格上漲，但漲幅仍低於記憶體與儲存產品，因此SoC已退居手機最昂貴零組件的第二位。

AI讓記憶體景氣週期變長　但沒有消失

從產業結構來看，AI確實正在改變記憶體市場的運作方式。HBM的高需求，加上大型科技公司提前多年簽訂供應協議，使記憶體業者獲得過去較少見的訂單能見度。
但這並不代表記憶體已永久脫離週期性。
Gartner最新預測顯示，2026年記憶體營收占整體半導體市場比重將達54%，遠高於2025年的約27%。這項變化也強化了市場對美光、SK海力士及三星等主要記憶體業者的樂觀看法。
然而，隨著新產能逐步開出，加上HBM以外的新技術可能出現替代方案，當供給最終追上甚至超越需求時，記憶體價格仍可能重新面臨壓力。
因此，AI更可能是延長並放大記憶體景氣循環，而非徹底消滅週期。目前由AI需求推升的8373億美元記憶體市場，未來仍必須面對供給擴張後可能出現的新一輪供需平衡。

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：博通財報、8月非農就業、利率路徑線索
items.title_en: Weekly Trading Notes: Broadcom Earnings, August Non‑Farm Payrolls, Fed Rate Path Clues
paras: 這周最新的美國勞動市場數據，以及半導體大廠博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)的季度業績，將考驗近期推動美股接近歷史高點的這波漲勢。
標普500指數上周上漲，距離8月13日創下的歷史新高僅略高於1%。上周三，AI指標企業輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)公布亮眼財報，提振股市情緒。此前市場情緒曾受到美國公債殖利率上升的打擊。
投資人將關注周五(9/4)公布的美國非農就業報告，以及這份報告是否會為聯準會(Fed)未來幾個月的利率政策提供線索。
Glenmede投資策略副總裁Michael Reynolds表示，「隨著我們開始接近9月的會議，每項數據都將受到密切檢視，因為這些數據可能影響聯準會最終會採取什麼行動。」
聯準會新任主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周五發表演講後，投資人提高了對央行9月會議升息的押注，聯準會目前正努力應對高於目標的通膨。

8月非農就業報告

8月接近尾聲，標普500指數今年迄今上漲超過12%。由AI基礎設施建設大規模支出所帶動的企業獲利強勁成長，正推動美股這場持續近四年的多頭行情。
隨著美國夏季即將結束，市場整體相對平靜。「恐慌指數」VIX徘徊在今年低點附近，上周每日市場成交量也遠低於2026年的平均水準。包括就業數據在內，未來幾項事件都可能引發資產市場波動。
根據《路透社》截至上周五的調查，市場預期8月非農就業人數增加5.8萬人，失業率維持在4.1%。7月的就業報告顯示勞動市場意外轉弱，就業人數減少2.3萬人。
PNC Asset Management Group投資長Amanda Agati表示，「上一份就業報告讓市場和投資人稍微停下腳步觀望。」不過，Agati不認為勞動市場已經失速，並稱她將關注「是否確認上一份報告所顯示的趨勢，或者就業市場可能反彈至前幾個月的水準」。

Fed利率路徑成焦點

就業數據也可能透露聯準會是否有可能升息。上周公布的數據顯示，通膨仍遠高於聯準會2%的年度目標。
升息將對股市表現帶來多項挑戰，包括提高消費者與企業的借貸成本。
聯邦基金期貨上周五晚間顯示，聯準會9月會議升息的機率為57%。投資人也擔心，如果就業報告顯示就業人數大幅增加、薪資成長明顯加快，市場對升息的押注可能進一步升高。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資組合經理Matt Stucky表示，「股市希望看到的是，數據持續讓聯準會有能力維持利率不變。」
這周還將公布製造業及服務業活動等其他經濟數據。美國供應管理協會(ISM)此前公布的月度數據顯示，美國製造業活動升至四年多來最高水準。
Stucky指出，「我們認為，這股動能能否延續至9月，是非常值得關注的。」

博通壓軸 Q2財報季近尾聲

博通周三(9/2)盤後將公布財報，這家半導體公司的市值最近約為1.7兆美元，也將成為市場焦點。此前，競爭對手輝達公布的業績提振了美股指數。
輝達預期下一會計年度的營收將大幅成長70%。對於這家AI指標企業而言，這是一項罕見的財測，因為輝達通常不會公布如此長期的營收預測。
Stucky表示，「我們想知道，博通是否也能提供同樣程度的可見度。」
這周還有科技公司戴爾(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)及Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)將公布財報。
隨著大多數企業已經公布業績，根據LSEG IBES數據，標普500指數成分股第二季獲利目前預計按調整後基準計算，較去年同期成長34.5%。
Reynolds表示，本次財報季展現了「非常強勁的核心獲利能力」。「如果最後幾家公司公布的財報也持續呈現這種情況，我認為這將對今年剩餘時間的市場展望形成非常正面的支撐。」
paras_en: This week’s latest U.S. labor market data and the quarterly earnings of semiconductor giant Broadcom (AVGO‑US) will test the recent rally that has pushed the U.S. equity market close to historic highs.

The S&P 500 rose last week, remaining just over 1% below the record high set on August 13. On Wednesday, AI‑chip maker Nvidia (NVDA‑US) released stellar earnings that lifted market sentiment, after earlier dampening from rising U.S. Treasury yields.
Weekly trading notes (0831‑0904)
Investors will focus on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report released on Friday (9/4) and whether it will provide clues for the Fed’s rate policy in the coming months.

Glenmede Investment Strategy Senior Vice President Michael Reynolds said, "As we approach the September meeting, every data point will be scrutinized closely because it could influence the Fed’s final action."
After Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech last Friday, investors increased bets on a September rate hike, as the Fed works to bring inflation back to target.

August Non‑Farm Payroll Report
At the end of August, the S&P 500 has risen more than 12% this year. Strong corporate earnings driven by large‑scale AI infrastructure spending are propelling the U.S. equity rally that has lasted nearly four years.

With the U.S. summer ending, the market remains relatively calm. The VIX hovered near this year’s low, and last week’s daily trading volume was far below the 2026 average. Several upcoming events, including employment data, could trigger market volatility.

According to a Reuters poll up to last Friday, the market expects August non‑farm payrolls to rise by 58,000 jobs and unemployment to stay at 4.1%. July’s report showed an unexpected labor market slowdown, with jobs falling by 23,000.

PNC Asset Management Group CIO Amanda Agati said, "The last employment report made the market and investors pause to observe." However, Agati does not believe the labor market has stalled and said she will watch whether the trend shown in the last report is confirmed or if the job market rebounds to previous levels.

Fed Rate Path Focus
Employment data may also reveal whether the Fed is likely to raise rates. Last week’s data showed inflation still far above the Fed’s 2% annual target.
Rate hikes will pose several challenges to the stock market, including higher borrowing costs for consumers and businesses.

Fed futures last Friday evening indicated a 57% probability of a September rate hike. Investors also worry that if the employment report shows a large increase in jobs and a clear acceleration in wage growth, bets on a rate hike could rise further.
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management portfolio manager Matt Stucky said, "The market wants to see data that continues to give the Fed the ability to keep rates unchanged."

Other economic data, such as manufacturing and services activity, will also be released this week. The Institute for Supply Management’s (ISM) latest monthly data showed U.S. manufacturing activity at its highest level in more than four years.
Stucky noted, "We believe it is worth watching whether this momentum can carry through to September."

Broadcom’s Q2 Earnings Close to the End of the Quarter
Broadcom will report after the market on Wednesday (9/2). The semiconductor company’s market cap is about $1.7 trillion and will be a market focus. Previously, Nvidia’s earnings had lifted the equity index.

Nvidia expects revenue for the next fiscal year to grow 70% year‑on‑year. For this AI‑chip maker, this is a rare long‑term revenue forecast, as Nvidia typically does not publish such extended projections.
Stucky said, "We want to know whether Broadcom can provide the same level of visibility."
This week, Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) will also report earnings.

With most companies having already released results, LSEG IBES data shows that S&P 500 constituents’ Q2 earnings are currently projected to grow 34.5% on an adjusted basis versus the same period last year.

Reynolds said the earnings season has shown "very strong core profitability." "If the last few companies to report continue to show this pattern, I believe it will provide very positive support for the market outlook for the rest of the year."

items.title: 美國CIA局長密訪莫斯科！拋川普、普丁、澤倫斯基三方峰會、俄烏談判9月有望重啟?
items.title_en: U.S. CIA Director Secretly Visits Moscow, Proposes Trump‑Putin‑Zelensky Trilateral Summit and Hopes Ukraine‑Russia Talks May Resume in September
paras: 美國中央情報局（CIA）局長雷克里夫（John Ratcliffe）本週秘密訪問莫斯科期間，據悉向俄方提出由美國總統川普、俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）及烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelensky）舉行三方峰會的構想，希望藉此重新推動俄烏和平談判。
根據《Axios》報導，雷克里夫此次赴莫斯科，是他首次親自參與川普政府推動俄烏外交突破的行動。
美國官員週五（28日）向澤倫斯基說明雷克里夫在莫斯科的會談內容，以及舉行三方峰會的提議。川普政府過去就曾提出這項構想。澤倫斯基已表態支持，但普丁一直拒絕。
消息人士表示，雷克里夫此次訪問的部分目的，是了解俄羅斯情報機構負責人是否能協助說服普丁，朝恢復由美國斡旋的俄烏談判方向邁進。
雷克里夫週二（26日）秘密抵達莫斯科，並與俄羅斯對外情報局（SVR）局長納雷什金（Sergey Naryshkin）及聯邦安全局（FSB）局長博爾特尼科夫（Alexander Bortnikov）會面。
此次會談中，雷克里夫也據悉向俄方釋放重新啟動和平談判的可能性。
《紐約時報》先前報導，雷克里夫向博爾特尼科夫說明俄烏戰爭目前的嚴峻局勢，並敦促俄羅斯趁情勢進一步惡化前達成協議。
知情人士則表示，雷克里夫在會談後認為，博爾特尼科夫是一名具有建設性的人物，可能有助於重新啟動外交努力。
川普則向《Axios》表示，雷克里夫此次訪問屬於「例行公務」，並非為了警告俄羅斯不要攻擊北約（NATO）領土。
川普政府特使威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）及川普女婿庫許納（Jared Kushner）近幾個月分別與俄羅斯及烏克蘭談判代表接觸，但雙方至今仍未取得重大突破。
由美國斡旋的俄烏談判在2月中旬暫停，此後美國與伊朗爆發戰爭，使外交工作的推進受到影響。
不過，澤倫斯基辦公室主任布達諾夫（Kyrylo Budanov）週四（27日）向當地媒體表示，美國斡旋的俄烏談判可能在9月重新啟動。
不過，俄烏談判能否重新啟動，仍面臨重大障礙。烏克蘭官員對普丁是否真心尋求和平抱持高度懷疑，並表示掌握的情報顯示，俄羅斯可能正在準備進一步擴大戰事。
澤倫斯基副幕僚長帕利薩（Pavlo Palisa）週五告訴記者，普丁已下令俄軍為在烏克蘭北部發動攻勢準備數套作戰方案，其中基輔（Kyiv）及切爾尼希夫（Chernihiv）被列為重要目標地區。
澤倫斯基週五則對美方近期與俄羅斯的接觸表示感謝，稱美國與俄方對話展現了「必要的基調」，並表示川普政府正在推動一套較為務實的方向，包括釐清目前需要採取哪些行動，以及最終必須達成哪些目標。
paras_en: During a secret visit to Moscow this week, CIA Director John Ratcliffe reportedly presented the idea of a three‑way summit involving U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, hoping to revive peace talks between Russia and Ukraine.
According to Axios, this trip to Moscow was Ratcliffe’s first personal involvement in a Trump‑administration effort to achieve a diplomatic breakthrough in the Russia‑Ukraine conflict.

U.S. officials briefed Zelensky on Friday (the 28th) about Ratcliffe’s discussions in Moscow and the proposal for a trilateral summit. The Trump administration had previously floated the idea. Zelensky has voiced support, but Putin has consistently refused.
Sources say part of Ratcliffe’s mission was to gauge whether senior Russian intelligence officials could help persuade Putin to move toward a U.S.-mediated Russia‑Ukraine negotiation track.
Ratcliffe arrived in Moscow covertly on Tuesday (the 26th) and met with SVR chief Sergey Naryshkin and FSB head Alexander Bortnikov.
During the talks, Ratcliffe is said to have signaled to the Russians that a restart of peace negotiations was possible.
The New York Times previously reported that Ratcliffe told Bortnikov about the dire state of the war and urged Russia to reach an agreement before the situation deteriorates further.
Insiders said that after the meeting Ratcliffe regarded Bortnikov as a constructive figure who could help restart diplomatic efforts.
Trump told Axios the visit was “routine business” and not intended as a warning to Russia against attacking NATO territory.
Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff and son‑in‑law Jared Kushner have been in contact with Russian and Ukrainian negotiators over the past months, but no major breakthroughs have been achieved.
U.S.-brokered Russia‑Ukraine talks were halted in mid‑February; subsequent U.S. involvement in a war with Iran has further hampered diplomatic progress.
However, Kyrylo Budanov, chief of Zelensky’s office, told local media on Thursday (the 27th) that the U.S.-mediated talks could be revived in September.
Whether the talks can restart remains uncertain. Ukrainian officials are highly skeptical that Putin genuinely seeks peace and say intelligence indicates Russia may be preparing to expand the war.

Deputy chief of staff Pavlo Palisa told reporters on Friday that Putin has ordered the Russian army to prepare several operational plans for an offensive in northern Ukraine, with Kyiv and Chernihiv identified as key target areas.

Zelensky thanked the United States on Friday for recent contacts with Russia, saying the dialogue showed a “necessary tone” and that the Trump administration is pushing a more pragmatic approach, clarifying needed actions and ultimate objectives.

items.title: 新疆直通北冰洋 中國、俄羅斯、哈薩克有新構想
items.title_en: Xinjiang Direct to the Arctic Ocean: China, Russia, Kazakhstan Explore New Route
paras: 紅海、荷姆茲海峽等全球航運要道屢受地緣衝突衝擊，一項連接中國新疆、哈薩克、俄羅斯、最終通往北冰洋的內陸運輸構想，再次進入外界視野。
據《南華早報》30日（周日）報導，中俄正在研究一條以額爾齊斯河—鄂畢河水系為核心的河海聯運通道，哈薩克也在積極推進相關河運開發計畫。
分析人士認為，這條線路最大意義並非取代現有海運，而是在極端地緣政治情況下，為中國開闢一條繞開馬六甲海峽、荷姆茲海峽等傳統海上咽喉的北極戰略備用通道。
這一構想的核心，是全長4,248公里的額爾齊斯河。它發源於中國新疆維吾爾自治區，流經哈薩克，匯入俄羅斯鄂畢河，最終注入北冰洋。
對中國而言，這條河海聯運航線將為內陸地區提供通往資源豐富、具有戰略意義的北極新通道。
上海國際問題研究院高級研究員趙隆表示，烏克蘭戰爭和荷姆茲海峽危機都提高了替代航運路線的戰略價值。
「無論陸路運輸走廊還是海上航線，都受到地緣政治衝突的影響，這些衝突的外溢效應越來越長期，越來越明顯。」
趙隆說：「因此，任何能夠提供更多運輸路線選擇的方案，都必然會獲得更大發展動力。」
然而，中俄哈要把額爾齊斯河真正建設成一條國際貿易大動脈並不容易。
首先，西伯利亞嚴寒冬季意味著航道每年最長凍結約6個月，商業航運可能只能集中於短暫夏季窗口。
不過，據俄羅斯鄂木斯克河港介紹，經額爾齊斯河南線向中國運輸貨物，通航期可從北極航道的約100天延長至近半年（約4月15日至11月15日），這在一定程度上緩解了冰封期制約。
其次，季節性低水位和嚴重泥沙淤積會不斷形成移動沙洲，需要持續大規模疏浚，才能確保大型貨駁安全通行。
俄羅斯鄂木斯克河港表示，為確保南線通航，部分河段需要疏浚，該港正與哈薩克和中國談判，希望對方展開河道勘測研究。
挪威北極大學教授馬克·蘭泰涅指出，各國在開發額爾齊斯河基礎設施的同時，必須兼顧其作為重要淡水水源的生態功能。
另一個關鍵挑戰，則是中俄在中亞影響力之間微妙而複雜的平衡。
他說：「哈薩克一直試圖實現地區夥伴多元化，包括加強與中國及裏海地區國家的聯繫；俄羅斯則希望繼續維持自己作為中亞安全保障者的傳統角色。」
俄羅斯遠東聯邦大學國際關係教授阿爾喬姆·盧金認為，額爾齊斯河要真正成為可通航國際運輸走廊，不僅需要巨額投資，更需要中俄哈三國建立前所未有的政治互信。「總成本可能高達數百億、甚至上千億美元，只有中國擁有如此規模的資源。」
「但中國是否願意為一個大部分位於俄羅斯和哈薩克境內的項目投入如此巨額資金？推進額爾齊斯河工程，需要中俄哈三國達到一個全新的互信與合作水準。」
paras_en: The Red Sea, the Strait of Hormuz, and other global shipping lanes have repeatedly been struck by geopolitical conflicts; a new inland transport concept linking China’s Xinjiang, Kazakhstan, Russia, and ultimately the Arctic Ocean has re-entered public attention.

According to a Sunday (30th) report by the South China Morning Post, China and Russia are studying a river‑sea transport corridor centered on the Ili‑Ob river system, while Kazakhstan is actively advancing related river transport development plans.

Analysts believe the greatest significance of this route is not to replace existing maritime shipping, but to provide China with a northern strategic backup corridor that bypasses traditional maritime choke points such as the Strait of Malacca and the Strait of Hormuz under extreme geopolitical conditions.

The core of this concept is the 4,248‑kilometre-long Ili River, which originates in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, flows through Kazakhstan, joins the Russian Ob River, and ultimately empties into the Arctic Ocean.
For China, this river‑sea corridor would provide inland regions with access to a resource‑rich, strategically significant Arctic new route.

Senior researcher Zhao Long of the Shanghai International Studies Institute said that the Ukraine war and the Strait of Hormuz crisis have increased the strategic value of alternative shipping routes.

"Whether it is a land transport corridor or a maritime route, they are affected by geopolitical conflicts, and the spill‑over effects of these conflicts are becoming longer‑term and more obvious," Zhao said.
Zhao added: "Therefore, any solution that offers more transport route options will inevitably receive greater development momentum."
However, it will not be easy for China, Russia, and Kazakhstan to turn the Ili River into an international trade artery.
First, the severe Siberian winter means the channel can be frozen for up to six months each year, so commercial shipping may only be possible during a brief summer window.

Nevertheless, according to the Ob River Port in Omsk, Russia, the shipping season for goods transported from China via the lower Ili River can be extended from about 100 days on the Arctic route to nearly half a year (approximately April 15 to November 15), which somewhat alleviates the ice‑blocking constraint.
Second, seasonal low water levels and severe sedimentation will continuously form mobile sandbars, requiring large‑scale dredging to ensure safe passage for large cargo vessels.

Omsk’s Ob River Port said that to ensure the southern line remains navigable, some river sections need dredging, and the port is negotiating with Kazakhstan and China, hoping the parties will conduct river‑bed surveys and research.

Professor Mark Lantine of the Norwegian University of Science and Technology pointed out that while developing Ili River infrastructure, countries must also consider its ecological function as an important freshwater source.
Another key challenge is the subtle and complex balance of influence between China and Russia in Central Asia.

He said: "Kazakhstan has been trying to diversify regional partnerships, strengthening ties with China and Caspian‑region countries; Russia, on the other hand, wants to continue maintaining its traditional role as a security guarantor in Central Asia."

Professor Arjom Lukin of Far Eastern Federal University in Russia believes that for the Ili River to become a truly navigable international transport corridor, it will require not only massive investment but also unprecedented political trust among China, Russia, and Kazakhstan. "The total cost could reach hundreds of billions, even trillions of dollars, and only China has resources on that scale," he said.

"But is China willing to invest such a huge amount of money in a project that lies mostly within Russian and Kazakh territory? Advancing the Ili River project requires China, Russia, and Kazakhstan to reach a new level of mutual trust and cooperation."

items.title: 諾獎得主克魯曼解讀華許首秀「偏鷹」！降息訊號全缺席：意外是個「正常Fed主席」
items.title_en: Nobel Laureate Krugman Interprets Warsh's First Jackson Hole Talk as ‘Hawkish’: No Rate‑Cut Signals, He’s a ‘Normal Fed Chair’
paras: 諾貝爾經濟學獎得主克魯曼（Paul Krugman）認為，美國聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）日前在傑克遜霍爾（Jackson Hole）發表的首次演說，真正值得關注的並非他說了什麼，而是刻意沒有提到哪些內容。
克魯曼週六（29日）接受《雅虎財經》（Yahoo Finance）訪問時表示，華許的演說整體基調相當傳統，並未釋放明確的降息訊號，也沒有展現出比其他聯準會官員更為鴿派的立場。若川普政府原本期待華許替降息政策背書，這次演說顯然沒有達到這個效果。
克魯曼指出，華許此次的政策論述甚至比過去更偏向鷹派，尤其是放棄先前對替代性通膨衡量方式的試探，重新強調官方通膨指標仍是判斷政策的重要依據。

克魯曼點出矛盾：聯準會喊停非常規政策　財政部卻買長債

克魯曼認為，華許演說中最值得注意的地方之一，是其對貨幣政策工具的立場，與美國財政部目前推動的政策存在明顯落差。
華許在演說中強調，短期利率仍是聯準會執行貨幣政策的主要工具，非常規措施則應僅在特殊情況下使用。
但克魯曼指出，財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）正在推動的長天期美國公債購買計畫，實質上與量化寬鬆（QE）具有相似性。
克魯曼表示：「華許說我們不再這麼做，但就在幾條街之外，他們正在這麼做。」他認為，這正是目前美國貨幣與財政政策之間最明顯的矛盾之一。
他表示，在財政部宣布雙重國債回購計畫後，財政部與聯準會之間的政策張力可能進一步浮現。
儘管華許上任前曾引發外界對聯準會政策獨立性的疑慮，市場也曾擔心他可能成為川普政府推動寬鬆政策的支持者，但克魯曼認為，這次演說反而帶來一定程度的正面訊號。
他表示，從華許此次的表現來看，目前看到的仍是一位相對正常的聯準會主席，是他認為市場所需要的結果。
克魯曼同時注意到，華許在演說中甚至沒有談及縮減聯準會資產負債表，而這項政策過去被視為他的核心主張之一。

AI經濟影響保持保留　克魯曼認為這反而是好事

至於人工智慧（AI）對美國經濟的影響，華許此次同樣沒有採取過度樂觀的論調。
華許承認AI正在推動投資增加，也指出外界對美國長期經濟停滯的疑慮似乎正在減弱，但並未進一步斷言AI將對生產力或通膨帶來什麼確定性的結果。
克魯曼對此反而給予肯定。他指出，華許過去曾暗示AI帶來的生產力提升可能有助於降低通膨壓力，但此次演說明顯沒有延續如此明確的判斷。
克魯曼認為，在AI對經濟究竟會產生多大影響這個問題上，保持未知立場反而是較為理性的做法，因為市場上幾乎可以找到支持不同論點的專家。
克魯曼尤其關注華許對通膨的態度。他指出，過去幾個月華許曾公開討論是否應採用不同的通膨衡量方式，甚至一度暗示實際通膨壓力可能沒有官方數據呈現的那麼嚴重。
但在傑克遜霍爾演說中，華許重新回到標準通膨指標，而目前該指標仍高於聯準會2%的政策目標。
克魯曼因此認為，華許這次演說的基調其實相當鷹派，核心訊息是在看到更多通膨改善證據之前，聯準會仍應維持相對緊縮的政策立場。

聯準會成立5大任務小組　克魯曼質疑只是「拖時間」

對於華許提到聯準會內部成立5個政策任務小組，並表示相關工作正在取得進展，克魯曼則持保留態度。
他認為，貨幣政策相關議題已經經過數十年的大量研究與討論，因此這些任務小組很難提出市場完全沒有聽過的新觀點。
克魯曼還引用聯準會理事沃勒（Chris Waller）據稱在一次晚宴上的說法，認為只要知道任務小組成員是誰，就大致能預測最後會提出什麼建議。
在克魯曼看來，這些任務小組更像是一種爭取時間的安排，而不是可能徹底改變聯準會政策方向的重大改革。

加拿大關稅若全面升級　克魯曼警告美國汽車業恐遭重創

除了聯準會政策，克魯曼也談到美加貿易關係。
他表示，目前美國與加拿大之間的關稅措施雖然已帶來破壞性影響，但涉及範圍仍相對有限；真正令人擔憂的是，若雙方進一步落實目前所威脅的加徵關稅及反制措施，衝擊可能急劇擴大。
克魯曼警告，若相關關稅措施全面落地，美國汽車產業可能受到極為嚴重的打擊。
他認為，目前局勢仍帶有一定程度的荒謬色彩，實際經濟衝擊尚未完全顯現，但最大的問題在於，外界目前仍無法確定這場關稅爭端最終會升級到什麼程度。
paras_en: Nobel economics laureate Paul Krugman says the most noteworthy aspect of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s first speech at Jackson Hole was not what he said, but what he deliberately left out.

Krugman told Yahoo Finance on Saturday the 29th that Warsh’s overall tone was conventional, offering no clear signal of rate cuts and no more dovish stance than other Fed officials. If the Trump administration had hoped Warsh would endorse easing, the speech fell short of that expectation.

Krugman noted that Warsh’s policy rhetoric was even more hawkish than before, especially after abandoning a tentative alternative inflation measure and re‑emphasizing the official inflation gauge as the key policy yardstick.
Krugman highlighted a contradiction: the Fed is pausing unconventional policy while the Treasury is buying long‑term bonds.
Warsh stressed that short‑term rates remain the Fed’s primary monetary‑policy tool and that unconventional measures should be used only in extraordinary circumstances.
Krugman pointed out that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s push for a long‑term U.S. bond‑buying program is essentially akin to quantitative easing.
“Warsh says we’re not doing that, but just a few streets away they are,” Krugman said, calling it one of the clearest frictions between U.S. monetary and fiscal policy today.
He added that after the Treasury announced a dual‑bond‑repurchase plan, policy tension between the Treasury and the Fed could become more pronounced.
Although Warsh’s appointment had raised doubts about Fed independence and sparked fears he might back Trump‑favoured easing, Krugman believes the speech actually sent a modestly positive signal.
He said Warsh’s performance suggests a relatively normal Fed chair, which is what the market needs.
Krugman also noted that Warsh did not even mention balance‑sheet reduction, a policy previously seen as his signature stance.
Regarding AI’s impact on the U.S. economy, Warsh again avoided overly optimistic language.

Warsh acknowledged that AI is spurring more investment and that concerns about long‑term stagnation seem to be easing, but he stopped short of claiming AI will definitively boost productivity or curb inflation.
Krugman praised that restraint, observing that Warsh had previously hinted AI‑driven productivity gains could ease inflation pressure, yet his latest remarks lacked such a definitive judgment.
He argued that maintaining an agnostic stance on AI’s economic impact is more rational, given the abundance of experts on both sides of the debate.

Krugman paid particular attention to Warsh’s view on inflation, recalling that in recent months Warsh publicly debated using alternative inflation metrics and even suggested underlying pressure might be milder than official data show.
In the Jackson Hole speech, however, Warsh reverted to the standard inflation gauge, which still sits above the Fed’s 2% target.
Thus Krugman sees the tone as decidedly hawkish, with the core message that the Fed should stay relatively tight until more concrete evidence of inflation improvement emerges.
Warsh mentioned that the Fed has set up five internal policy task forces and claimed progress on their work, a point Krugman treats with skepticism.
He argues that decades of research have already covered monetary‑policy issues, making it unlikely these task forces will produce truly novel insights.
Krugman also cited Fed Governor Chris Waller’s alleged comment at a dinner that knowing the task‑force members essentially predicts the recommendations they’ll issue.
In Krugman’s view, the task forces are more about buying time than delivering a transformative policy shift.
Beyond Fed policy, Krugman turned to U.S.–Canada trade relations.

He said current tariff measures between the U.S. and Canada have been disruptive but remain limited in scope; the real worry is that further implementation of threatened tariffs and retaliations could dramatically widen the impact.
Krugman warned that if the full suite of proposed tariffs were enacted, the U.S. auto industry could suffer a severe blow.

He added that the situation still carries a degree of absurdity, with the full economic fallout not yet evident, but the biggest problem is the uncertainty over how far the tariff dispute will ultimately escalate.

items.title: 虹堡庫藏股執行率53%、均價51.96元 下半年獲利拚回升
items.title_en: Hongbao Treasury Stock Execution Rate 53%, Average Price NT$51.96, Profit Aims to Recover in H2
paras: 工業電腦廠虹堡(5258-TW)公告，買回庫藏股期間屆滿，斥資4143萬元買回797張庫藏股，買回均價51.96元，相較原定買回1500張，執行率約53%；虹堡下半年受惠訂單動能回升，力拚獲利表現好轉。
虹堡原預定自6月30日至8月29日買回1500張庫藏股，買回區間價格34.2-77.9元，實際執行期間則為7月3日至8月27日。
虹堡說明，為維護全體股東權益及兼顧市場交易機制，此次庫藏股視股價變化及成交量狀況採分批買回策略，故未執行完畢，而根據公司原預定規劃，買回庫藏股將轉讓予員工。
營運展望方面，虹堡先前法說會指出，上半年受到記憶體價格飆漲、客戶下單觀望，營運表現低於預期，但隨著記憶體價格趨穩，下半年訂單動能回升、毛利率也可望改善，全年獲利可望較去年持平甚至略升。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Hongbao (5258-TW) announced that the treasury‑stock repurchase period has ended, spending NT$41.43 million to buy back 797 lots of treasury stock at an average price of NT$51.96 per share, representing an execution rate of about 53% compared with the originally planned 1,500 lots; Hongbao expects order momentum to pick up in the second half of the year and is striving for an improvement in profit performance.
Hongbao originally scheduled to repurchase 1,500 lots of treasury stock from June 30 to August 29, with a price range of NT$34.2–77.9; the actual execution period was July 3 to August 27.

Hongbao explained that to protect the interests of all shareholders and respect market trading mechanisms, the treasury‑stock buy‑back was carried out in batches based on price movements and trading volume, so it was not completed. According to the original plan, the repurchased shares will be transferred to employees.

Regarding operating outlook, Hongbao previously stated at its earnings conference that the first half was hurt by soaring memory‑chip prices and cautious customer ordering, resulting in performance below expectations. With memory prices stabilising, order momentum is expected to recover in the second half and gross margin should improve, allowing full‑year profit to be roughly flat with last year or slightly higher.

items.title: 工總率團赴印簽6項MOU 鏈結電子供應鏈將交流走向實際落地
items.title_en: Industrial Federation Delegation Visits India, Signs Six MOUs; Electronics Supply Chain Links Move Toward Concrete Implementation
paras: 為深化台、印度產業合作，掌握全球供應鏈重組及新興科技發展商機，工總由印度分組召集人、東元(1504-TW)集團董事長利明献率團赴印度班加羅爾展開系列產業交流，並與印度商工總會(FICCI)舉辦的「2026台印產業鏈結高峰論壇」，會中雙方共簽署六項合作備忘錄，也鏈結政府、電子供應鏈、智慧車輛、綠色智慧科技及數位轉型等產業公協會及企業代表合作契機。
工總表示，論壇邀請FICCI主席Siddhartha Agarwal、印度商工部次長Amardeep Singh Bhatia，經濟部次長江文若、印度台北協會會長Ninad S. Deshpande、駐印度代表處及印度台商總會總會長陳木騰共同出席，從政策、產業及企業角度交流台印投資布局與供應鏈發展。
利明献表示，全球供應鏈重組正改變企業海外布局思維，投資海外已不再只是追求成本優勢，而是更加重視供應鏈韌性、市場布局及整體解決方案能力。
利明献也以東元為例，近年持續拓展AI資料中心基礎建設、載具電化、能源服務解決方案等海外市場，並協同國際CSP(雲端服務供應商)客戶發展超大型資料中心整體解決方案，展現台灣企業已由產品出口逐步邁向技術整合、工程服務及策略市場和關鍵客戶的戰略布局。
江文若則指出，台印經貿關係近年持續升溫，去(2025)年雙邊貿易額達125.1億美元，創歷史新高，台商赴印度投資亦持續增加，產業布局更加多元，包括近期臺灣ETC電子收費系統已在印度投入營運，而班加羅爾TIIP園區也成為臺灣企業與印度夥伴深化合作的重要據點，期待雙方進一步深化產業鏈結，建立更具韌性的供應鏈夥伴關係。
陳木騰則表示，隨著台灣電子業加快印度布局，當地能否形成足以支撐企業長期營運的產業環境，將是下一階段臺印合作深化的關鍵。除了投資誘因外，在地供應商能量、技術人才、基礎建設、行政效率及政策穩定性，都將直接影響企業擴大投資的意願。
陳木騰強調，未來若能進一步強化投資保障與產業配套，並促進臺印企業共同投入技術、人才及供應鏈建設，將有助台商由個別企業投資逐步形成產業聚落，為企業長期扎根印度創造更有利的條件。
工總表示，會中共簽署六項合作備忘錄。在電子供應鏈方面，昇頻公司將與印度合作夥伴共同拓展印度電信市場及政府標案，推動工業乙太網路、物聯網通訊設備及智慧解決方案應用。
優勝奈米與Techazar E-cyclers Pvt. Ltd.合作，導入台灣電子廢棄物回收技術，推動資源循環再利用；禾麟數碼與 Green Source合作，將影像控制系統導入印度教育及商務市場，並規劃於印度國家電子學院建置示範場域，拓展台灣智慧教育解決方案。
綠色智慧科技方面，台灣資源循環產業推動協會與印度塑膠協會簽署合作備忘錄，未來將透過技術交流、論壇互訪及研究合作，共享市場資訊與研究成果，共同推動資源循環及永續產業合作；燿釷鋰可生公司與印度The Recycling Company 合作，共同推動電子廢棄物回收專案，除評估建置示範場域外，也將規劃進行設備驗證及人員培訓，期望建立標準化回收流程，促進回收技術落地及循環經濟發展。
泰創工程與印度 Shakti Plastic Industries 將合作聚焦於再生與永續材料，進一步探索其導入綠建築及ESG 工程應用的可行模式，拓展永續材料多元再利用的應用場域。
工總表示，未來將持續透過臺印度產業鏈結平台，串聯雙方政府、產業公協會及企業資源，並依台商投資與在地合作需求加強對接，推動更多合作案由交流走向實際落地。
paras_en: To deepen Taiwan‑India industrial cooperation and capture opportunities from global supply‑chain restructuring and emerging‑technology development, the Industrial Federation, led by its India subgroup head and TECO (1504‑TW) Group chairman Li Ming‑xian, traveled to Bangalore for a series of industry exchanges and co‑hosted the “2026 Taiwan‑India Industrial Chain Summit Forum” with the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI). During the forum the two sides signed six memoranda of understanding, linking governments, electronics supply chains, smart vehicles, green smart technology and digital transformation associations and corporate representatives for cooperation.

The Federation noted that the forum invited FICCI chairman Siddhartha Agarwal, Indian Ministry of Commerce Deputy Secretary Amardeep Singh Bhatia, Taiwan’s Deputy Minister of Economic Affairs Jiang Wen‑ruo, president of the India‑Taipei Association Ninad S. Deshpande, as well as the head of Taiwan’s representative office in India and the president of the Indian Taiwanese Business Association Chen Mu‑teng, all of whom discussed Taiwan‑India investment layouts and supply‑chain development from policy, industry and corporate perspectives.

Li Ming‑xian said that the ongoing reshaping of global supply chains is changing how companies think about overseas deployment; investing abroad is no longer just about cost advantage but increasingly about supply‑chain resilience, market positioning and comprehensive solution capabilities.

He cited TECO as an example, noting that in recent years the company has continuously expanded into overseas markets such as AI data‑center infrastructure, vehicle electrification and energy‑service solutions, and has collaborated with international cloud‑service providers to develop ultra‑large data‑center turnkey solutions, illustrating how Taiwanese firms are shifting from pure product export to technology integration, engineering services and strategic market placement for key customers.

Jiang Wen‑ruo pointed out that Taiwan‑India trade relations have been heating up, with bilateral trade reaching a record US$12.51 billion in 2024, and Taiwanese investment in India continuing to grow and diversify. Recent examples include Taiwan’s ETC electronic toll‑collection system now operating in India and the TIIP park in Bangalore becoming a key hub for deeper Taiwan‑India corporate collaboration. He expressed hope for further strengthening of industrial linkages and building a more resilient supply‑chain partnership.

Chen Mu‑teng said that as Taiwan’s electronics sector accelerates its footprint in India, the ability of the local ecosystem to support long‑term corporate operations will be crucial for the next phase of Taiwan‑India cooperation. Beyond investment incentives, the depth of local suppliers, technical talent, infrastructure, administrative efficiency and policy stability will directly affect companies’ willingness to expand investment.

He emphasized that strengthening investment protection and industrial support, and encouraging Taiwan‑India firms to jointly invest in technology, talent and supply‑chain development, will help Taiwanese investors evolve from isolated company projects to an industrial cluster, creating more favorable conditions for long‑term rooting in India.

The Federation reported that six MOUs were signed at the forum. In the electronics supply‑chain arena, Ascend Frequency Co. will partner with an Indian counterpart to expand into India’s telecom market and government projects, promoting industrial Ethernet, IoT communication equipment and smart‑solution applications.

Uwin Nanotech will cooperate with Techazar E‑cyclers Pvt. Ltd. to introduce Taiwanese e‑waste recycling technology and promote resource circularity; Heli Digital will work with Green Source to bring its imaging control systems to India’s education and business markets and plan a demonstration site at the National Electronics Institute of India, expanding Taiwan’s smart‑education solutions.

In green smart technology, the Taiwan Resource Recycling Industry Promotion Association signed an MOU with the Indian Plastics Association to share market information, conduct technology exchanges, forum visits and joint research, jointly advancing resource recycling and sustainable industry cooperation. Yao‑Lu Lithium Co. will partner with India’s The Recycling Company on e‑waste recycling projects, evaluating demonstration sites, equipment validation and staff training to establish standardized recycling processes and foster circular‑economy development.

Taiwanese Tai‑Chuang Engineering will collaborate with India’s Shakti Plastic Industries on regenerated and sustainable materials, exploring their application in green building and ESG engineering projects and expanding the use cases for diversified sustainable‑material reuse.

The Federation said it will continue to use the Taiwan‑India industrial‑chain platform to connect governments, industry associations and corporate resources on both sides, and will strengthen matchmaking based on Taiwanese investment needs and local cooperation demands, driving more projects from dialogue to concrete implementation.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉外資連4買點讚 穩懋周漲17.69％站上所有均線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Foreign Investors Buy 4 Times in a Row, Wenshao Surges 17.69% to Cross All Moving Averages
paras: 三五族砷化鎵PA放大廠穩懋(3105-TW)受惠於AI基礎建設、光通訊需求強勁，穩懋董事長陳進財表示，穩懋產品組合上，已逐步轉型成功，上周更在外資連4買1.2萬張挹注下，周漲17.69％ 成交量爆增至14.4萬張，股價不僅量增價揚衝上500元大關，周線收紅，也站上所有均線。
穩懋近年在產品逐步轉型下，今(2026)年業績表現也持續加溫，第2季稅後淨利9.77億元、季增83%，較去(2025)年同期轉虧為盈、單季EPS 2.3元，累計今年上半年稅後純益15.1億元、EPS達3.56元，也較去年轉盈。
法人指出，隨著AI大廠輝達(NVDA-US)持續推進矽光子CPO交換器量產，加上低軌衛星及光通訊需求逐步成長，有望為穩懋增添新一波成長動能。
穩懋表示，穩懋近年產品從原本最大宗手機PA放大器代工，公司經過這2、3年的改變，加上AI產品需求旺盛下，穩懋已轉變著重在光通訊、太空通訊、國防及AI基礎建設產品上持續努力，占比已超過手機比例。法人預估，穩懋未來有望隨AI產品暢旺下，持續帶動業績增長。
展望下半年業績，法人表示，穩懋雖從記憶體持續缺貨到供應鏈或終端的售價調漲，為今年手機旺季的整體銷售面帶來不確定性干擾，但公司仍持續聚焦於中高階Android及iOS市場上，並具有原有的代工廠競爭優勢，對高階手機拉貨動能並不悲觀，也持續將GaAs(砷化鎵) pHEMT、GaN(氮化鎵)等技術延伸至低軌衛星、太空通訊等領域布局。
paras_en: Wenshao (3105‑TW), a GaAs PA amplifier manufacturer, benefits from strong demand for AI infrastructure and optical communications. Chairman Chen Jincai said the company’s product mix has gradually transformed successfully. Last week, with four consecutive foreign‑investor purchases of 12,000 lots, the stock rose 17.69% during the week, trading volume surged to 144,000 lots, and the price not only climbed above the 500‑NT$ mark but also closed the week in red while crossing all moving averages.

In recent years, Wenshao’s gradual product transformation has kept its performance heating up. In 2026, the company’s Q2 after‑tax net profit reached 977 million NTD, up 83% from the same period last year, turning a loss into a profit and achieving a quarterly EPS of 2.30 NTD. Cumulative after‑tax profit for the first half of the year was 1.51 billion NTD, with an EPS of 3.56 NTD, also turning a loss into a profit compared with last year.

The analyst noted that as AI giant NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) continues to push silicon photonics CPO switch mass production, and with the growing demand for low‑Earth‑orbit satellites and optical communications, Wenshao is expected to gain a new wave of growth momentum.

Wenshao explained that its product line has shifted from primarily mobile PA amplifiers to focus on optical communications, space communications, defense, and AI infrastructure products, which now account for more than the mobile share. The analyst estimates that with the booming AI product demand, Wenshao’s revenue growth should continue.

Looking ahead to the second half, the analyst said that although continuous memory shortages and price hikes in the supply chain or end‑market have introduced uncertainty to the overall mobile sales during this year’s peak season, the company remains focused on the mid‑to‑high‑end Android and iOS markets. With its existing contract‑manufacturing advantage, the analyst is not pessimistic about high‑end phone demand and continues to extend GaAs pHEMT and GaN technologies into low‑Earth‑orbit satellite and space‑communication fields.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉9月開局4萬6多空拔河 外資回流動能成行情一大關鍵
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: September Opens Above 46,000 as Foreign Capital Inflows Drive the Trend
paras: 美國聯準會主席鮑爾釋出鷹派態度，市場預期9月升息的機率升高，衝擊美股周五盤面，加上MSCI(明晟)最新一季度調整將於周一(31日)生效，有可能在當天尾盤量價劇烈震盪，也令台股本周9月開局面臨雜音，台股交易員認為，輝達財報帶動的多方氣勢具一定的撐盤力度，再加上正處電子傳統旺季，即將公布的8月營收可期，因此，站上4萬6後若行情拉回，低接動能也不弱，先觀察外資回流的力道能否延續。
三大法人8月以來截至28日合計買超 3746 億元，其中外資買超達 3295 億元，也是連續兩個月大幅賣超後轉買。

外資呈現連4周買超，20個交易日來買超最多者依序為主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、 主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)、主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)、 元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)、元大台灣50(0050-TW)、南亞科(2408-TW)、陽明(2609-TW)、 華新(1605-TW)、元大台灣50正2(00631L-TW)和統一(1216-TW)，顯然回補台股以主動式ETF為主軸。
台股交易員認為，市場預測在華許發言後聯準會9月升息機率升至50%，但基本面又有AI長多格局撐盤，因此，9月行情處多空交戰，不過度悲觀，區間整理中可望驚驚逐步走出新行情。
永豐投顧分析，輝達8月財報優於市場預期，其台灣供應鏈在出貨量增加且毛利率提升的情況下，台股整體 EPS 值得關注。
不過，從籌碼面來看，若大盤量能未能放大，短期內可能仍會拉回修正，若指數跌破 44900 點均線帶且連續數個交易日未能收復，則盤整格局延續，待籌碼重新沉澱後再行評估。
永豐投顧也統計，美國11月期中選舉年的選前三個月股市偏弱，在選後轉強，以 1990 年以來九屆選舉年來看，台股選前三個月(8月)開始到11月報酬中位數為負，九屆中僅三屆上漲，歷史分布隱含的路徑，為選前震盪整理、選後動能轉強。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell’s hawkish stance has raised expectations of a September rate hike, impacting U.S. equities on Friday. Coupled with the MSCI (Morningstar) Q1 adjustment taking effect on Monday (31st), the market may see sharp volume‑price swings late that day, adding noise to Taiwan’s September opening. Taiwanese traders believe that Nvidia’s earnings have provided a solid bullish push, and with the traditional electronics peak season approaching, August revenue is expected to be strong. Thus, after breaking 46,000, if the market pulls back, the momentum remains strong; the focus will be on whether foreign capital inflows continue to sustain the trend.

Since August, the three major institutional investors have accumulated a net purchase of 374.6 billion NTD through the 28th, with foreign investors buying 329.5 billion NTD—marking a shift from two consecutive months of large net selling to buying.

Foreign investors have posted four consecutive weeks of net buying. Over the past 20 trading days, the top net buyers were: United Microelectronics’ active Unified 50 (00403A‑TW), United Microelectronics’ active Taiwan Stock Growth (00981A‑TW), United Microelectronics’ active Future 50 (00991A‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), Nan Ya Tech (2408‑TW), Yang Ming (2609‑TW), Hua Shin (1605‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L‑TW), and Uni-President (1216‑TW). The focus is clearly on actively managed ETFs.

Taiwan traders expect that after the Chinese comment, the probability of a September Fed rate hike rises to 50%, yet the fundamental AI-driven bullish trend supports the market. September will see a battle between bulls and bears, but not overly pessimistic; a range‑bound consolidation could gradually lead to a new trend.

Yongfeng Securities notes that Nvidia’s August earnings surpassed expectations, and Taiwan’s supply chain saw increased shipments and higher gross margins, making the overall EPS of Taiwanese stocks worth watching.

However, from a position‑holding perspective, if market volume does not expand, a short‑term pullback may occur. If the index falls below the 44,900‑point moving average and fails to recover for several consecutive days, the consolidation pattern will persist. After positions settle, a new assessment can be made.

Yongfeng Securities also reports that in the first three months of U.S. midterm election years, the market tends to be weak, turning strong afterward. Since 1990, in nine election years, the median return from August to November has been negative, with only three of the nine years showing gains. Historically, this pattern implies pre‑election volatility and post‑election momentum.

items.title: 矽力-KY AI含金量升高 明年資料中心營收占比拚逾2成
items.title_en: Silicon Power-KY AI Value Rises, Data Center Revenue Share to Exceed 20% Next Year
paras: 電源管理IC廠矽力*-KY (6415-TW)釋出新展望，董事長陳偉表示，隨AI基礎建設投資持續升溫，半導體產能轉趨吃緊，電源管理晶片(PMIC)需求也進入上升週期，展望第三季，儘管筆電、通訊等部分終端需求偏弱，但資料中心需求快速成長，預期本季營收將較第二季續增，下半年將由資料中心與汽車電子扮演兩大成長引擎。
陳偉指出，公司過往第三季營運多半持平第二季或小幅成長，今年情況略有不同，筆電市場動能相對疲弱，但AI基礎建設需求明顯升溫，包括資料中心電源、通訊模組、儲存及主機板等應用皆快速成長，加上目前整體供需仍偏緊，預期第三季營運仍可維持向上走勢。
其中，資料中心將成為矽力*-KY未來數年最重要的成長來源。陳偉表示，公司資料中心相關產品涵蓋Vcore、eFuse、訊號鏈晶片，以及數位控制器、閘極驅動器與各類電源管理IC等，多項產品已獲得客戶導入，並將自第三、第四季陸續進入客戶端，尤其主機板相關應用更有望成為未來兩年成長最快的產品線之一。
在AI運算領域，矽力Vcore產品目前已於伺服器CPU及客製化ASIC平台進行驗證，部分客戶近期可望進入試產；SPS過去主要應用於通訊設備，今年已切入伺服器、AI ASIC及先進駕駛輔助系統(ADAS)市場，最快第四季試產，預計2027年開始貢獻營收。
隨新品陸續放量，矽力*-KY資料中心業務第二季營收占比已達約15%至16%，預期2027年占比有機會突破20%。由於資料中心相關產品毛利率普遍高於公司平均水準，隨營收比重持續提高，除了推升整體營收規模，也可望改善產品組合並提升中長期毛利率。
汽車電子則為下半年另一成長主軸。陳偉指出，雖然中國大陸整體車市表現仍相對疲弱，但當地品牌持續擴大海外出口，終端需求與去年同期相比並未明顯轉弱，公司受惠更多新產品進入量產、客戶數持續增加，車用產品線呈現全面成長。
此外，工業應用需求也保持強勁，除資料中心外，包括太陽能、儲能、電動車充電基礎設施及能源計量晶片等應用皆維持不錯動能；消費性市場雖部分客戶需求較弱，但隨新一代Gen 4產品競爭力提升，公司在客戶端市占率仍持續增加。
製程升級方面，矽力Gen 4產品導入速度持續加快，陳偉表示，尤其近期全球半導體供應鏈轉趨吃緊後，汽車客戶對新製程產品的採用意願較過去積極，公司維持第四季Gen 4營收占比達20%的目標。12吋產能目前主要用於生產Gen 4產品，明年則可能開始有部分Gen 5產品進入試產。
不過，供應鏈吃緊也對短期成本造成壓力。陳偉坦言，第二季毛利率略為下滑，主要是供應端成本上升速度較快，包括原材料價格上漲及產能瓶頸，使公司無法立即完全吸收成本壓力，因此今年毛利率仍可能呈現小幅波動。
陳偉認為，短期成本壓力並不改變中長期毛利率改善趨勢，隨Gen 4及資料中心高毛利產品營收占比逐步提高，產品組合將持續優化，毛利率仍有向上空間。目前供應鏈瓶頸也已逐漸由晶圓端轉向封裝測試，公司正持續擴充自有測試產能，有助縮短後段交期並提升供應彈性。
陳偉認為，目前全球半導體產能仍相當緊張，尤其8吋產能需求持續增加，電源管理IC正處於上升週期，公司過去一年已提前積極備貨、建立庫存，如今隨需求回升，相關布局正逐步轉化為營運成果。展望未來半年，AI資料中心需求仍將維持強勁，搭配車用新品放量與Gen 4滲透率提升，將成為公司下一階段營運成長的主要支柱。
paras_en: Power management IC maker Silicon Power-KY (6415-TW) released a new outlook, with Chairman Chen Wei stating that as AI infrastructure investment continues to heat up and semiconductor capacity tightens, the demand for power management chips (PMICs) is entering an upward cycle. Looking ahead to Q3, although demand for laptops and communications is weak, data center demand is growing rapidly, so revenue this quarter is expected to continue rising from Q2, with data centers and automotive electronics becoming the two main growth engines in the second half of the year.

Chen Wei noted that the company’s Q3 operations have usually been flat or slightly higher than Q2, but this year is slightly different: the laptop market momentum is relatively weak, yet AI infrastructure demand is clearly heating up, including data center power supplies, communication modules, storage, and motherboard applications, all growing rapidly. With overall supply and demand still tight, Q3 operations are still expected to trend upward.

Data centers will become Silicon Power-KY’s most important growth source in the coming years. Chen Wei said the company’s data center products cover Vcore, eFuse, signal chain chips, as well as digital controllers, gate drivers, and various power management ICs. Several products have already been adopted by customers and will gradually enter the customer side in Q3 and Q4, especially motherboard-related applications, which are expected to become one of the fastest-growing product lines in the next two years.

In the AI computing field, Silicon Power’s Vcore products have already been verified on server CPUs and custom ASIC platforms, and some customers are expected to enter pilot production soon. SPS, which was previously mainly used in communication equipment, has now entered the server, AI ASIC, and advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) markets, with pilot production as early as Q4 and revenue contributions expected to start in 2027.

With new products gradually rolling out, Silicon Power-KY’s data center business accounted for about 15% to 16% of Q2 revenue, and the share is expected to exceed 20% in 2027. Because data center products generally have higher gross margins than the company’s average, as the revenue share continues to rise, it will not only lift overall revenue scale but also improve the product mix and raise medium‑to‑long‑term gross margins.

Automotive electronics is another growth axis for the second half of the year. Chen Wei said that although the overall Chinese mainland car market remains relatively weak, local brands continue to expand overseas exports, and end‑user demand has not weakened significantly compared to the same period last year. The company benefits from more new products entering mass production and a growing customer base, with the automotive product line showing comprehensive growth.

Industrial applications also remain strong. In addition to data centers, applications such as solar, energy storage, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and energy metering chips all maintain good momentum. The consumer market is weaker for some customers, but with the competitiveness of the new Gen 4 products improving, the company’s market share in the customer side continues to grow.

Process upgrades: Silicon Power’s Gen 4 products are being adopted at an accelerating pace. Chen Wei said that especially after the global semiconductor supply chain tightened, automotive customers have been more proactive in adopting new process products. The company maintains a target of 20% of Q4 Gen 4 revenue share. The 12‑inch capacity is currently mainly used to produce Gen 4 products, and next year some Gen 5 products may begin pilot production.

However, supply chain tightening also puts short‑term cost pressure. Chen Wei admitted that Q2 gross margin slipped slightly, mainly because supply‑side cost increases outpaced the company’s ability to absorb them, including rising raw material prices and capacity bottlenecks, so gross margin may still fluctuate slightly this year.

Chen Wei believes that short‑term cost pressure does not change the medium‑to‑long‑term gross margin improvement trend. As the revenue share of high‑margin Gen 4 and data center products gradually increases, the product mix will continue to optimize, and gross margin still has upside potential. The supply‑chain bottleneck is gradually shifting from wafer to packaging and testing, and the company is expanding its own test capacity to shorten downstream lead times and improve supply flexibility.

Chen Wei believes that global semiconductor capacity remains tight, especially the demand for 8‑inch capacity continues to rise. Power management ICs are in an upward cycle, and the company has been proactively stocking and building inventory over the past year. Now that demand is rebounding, the related layout is gradually turning into operational results. Looking ahead to the next six months, AI data center demand will remain strong, coupled with automotive new product volume and Gen 4 penetration, which will become the main pillar of the company’s next operational growth.

items.title: 內外資齊力拱盤！法人：從權值股轉到中小型題材 台股Risk-on訊號亮燈
items.title_en: Foreign and Domestic Investors Rally Together! Corporations Shift from Large-Weighted Stocks to Small and Mid-Cap Themes – Taiwanese Stock Market Risk-On Signal Lights Up
paras: 近期台股重回多頭結構，外資轉買且內資活躍，資金由大型權值股擴散至中小型題材股，展現 Risk-on (風險偏好) 訊號。安聯投信指出，AI 仍是確定性最高的成長趨勢，Rubin 平台量產與強勁接單支撐長線動能，即便面臨美一般消費轉弱與地緣政治干擾，台股基本面依然堅實。建議透過主動式投資靈活配置，掌握輪動契機與企業獲利成長潛力。
安聯台灣大壩基金經理人蕭惠中表示，近期市場波動來自信心面與籌碼面，信心面被美債、升息、中東局勢、AI規格與出貨變化干擾，籌碼面則被信心面與持股成本左右；市場自4月來至今，AI股高低起伏，沒變的是基本面，但信心面與籌碼面顯現則在不同階段出現不同的解釋與行為。有品質的AI股可持續高歌，基本面轉佳的非AI股也會有擁護者，看好台股後市。
至於美國消費力道轉弱未來潛在可能對台股的影響？安聯台灣智慧基金經理人陳思銘表示，美國8月零售銷售出現近九個月首度下滑，零售下滑、勞動市場走弱、油價偏高與長天期公債殖利率居高不下，四項風險同時浮現，雖對部份傳產股有所影響，但無礙台股表現，主因AI供應鏈才是多頭重心，且就經濟部預期8月份外銷接單年增率可達60%以上來看，資通訊接單強勁逐以抵銷北美一般消費可能轉弱的影響。
對於聯準會政策走向又將如何牽動台股？陳思銘表示，7月底聯準會 以9比3維持利率在3.50%–3.75%，下次FOMC會議為9月15–16日，目前市場預期以維持利率不變為多數，以美國財政部都主動介入美債殖利率升高的議題並採取積極的購債行為來壓抑殖利率，我們認為維持利率不變是可能的決策，因此9月的FOMC對市場影響有限。
題材面來看，蕭惠中表示，美國AI巨頭重要科技財測優於預期，配合Rubin平台即將量產，市場重回AI正向輪動，其資本支出展望亦對AI投資起到關鍵作用，說明2027年AI硬體需求將維持逾五成的成長率，有助支撐AI供應鍵股價表現。就目前接單狀況，CoWoS以及HBM到2027年都供不應求，2028年也沒有平衡的預期。在非電題材部分，可留意無人機、生技醫療。
評價面部分，蕭惠中表示，產業成長階段看的是趨勢方向與獲利上修幅度；截至目前為止，2026年台股企業獲利成長率已上修至六成以上，且上修獲利個股數仍高於下修者，在方向不變、幅度增加沒有改變之前，評價影響相對較低。專注議題上可留意8月31日MSCI權重調整、新iPhone發表，AI晶片進度與規格變化。
安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆表示，台股後市有望受惠於Rubin量產、TPU新品上市與資金回流力道；但評價面、美債殖利率走高與地緣政治仍將持續牽動市場走勢。近期台股在資金持續於電子、金融與傳產間輪動，仍有利反覆消化漲多後的估值修正與洗清籌碼。
廖本隆指出，AI仍是目前最具確定性的產業成長趨勢，在AI、高效能運算(HPC)以及半導體長線需求持續擴張下，產業成長趨勢並未改變；建議投資上應將更加重視企業獲利成長實際落地情形與評價合理性。在此環境下，主動式投資透過靈活調整產業配置與精選具競爭優勢企業，有望掌握市場輪動機會，兼顧成長潛力與收益需求。
paras_en: Recently, the Taiwanese stock market has returned to a bullish structure, with foreign investors buying and domestic investors active, as capital spreads from large-cap weighted stocks to small- and mid-cap thematic stocks, demonstrating a risk-on signal. Allianz Investment Trust notes that AI remains the most certain growth trend, with the Rubin platform’s mass production and strong order flow supporting long-term momentum. Even amid weaker U.S. consumer spending and geopolitical disruptions, Taiwan’s fundamentals remain solid. They recommend flexible active investment to capture rotation opportunities and corporate profit growth potential.

Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund manager Hsu Hui-chung says recent market volatility stems from confidence and position aspects. Confidence is affected by U.S. Treasury, rate hikes, Middle East situation, AI specifications and shipment changes, while positions are influenced by confidence and holding costs. Since April, AI stocks have fluctuated, but fundamentals remain unchanged; confidence and position aspects manifest differently at various stages. Quality AI stocks can sustain high performance, and non-AI stocks with improving fundamentals also attract supporters, boosting expectations for Taiwan’s market.

Regarding the potential impact of weaker U.S. consumer strength on Taiwan’s market, Allianz Taiwan Smart Fund manager Chen Si-ming notes that U.S. retail sales fell for the first time in nine months in August. The decline in retail, a weakening labor market, high oil prices, and persistently high long-term Treasury yields present four simultaneous risks. While some traditional industry stocks are affected, they do not hinder Taiwan’s performance, as the AI supply chain remains the bullish focus. Moreover, with the Ministry of Economic Affairs expecting an export order growth rate of over 60% in August, strong ICT order flow offsets any potential weakening of North American consumer demand.

On the Fed’s policy direction and its impact on Taiwan’s market, Chen Si-ming says that at the end of July the Fed kept rates at 3.50%–3.75% with a 9-to-3 vote. The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for September 15–16, and most market expectations favor a rate hold. The U.S. Treasury actively intervenes to raise Treasury yields and adopts aggressive bond-buying to suppress yields. We believe a rate hold is a likely decision, so the September FOMC will have limited market impact.

From a thematic perspective, Hsu Hui-chung notes that U.S. AI giants’ technology metrics beat expectations, and with the Rubin platform set for mass production, the market returns to a positive AI rotation. Capital expenditure outlook also plays a key role in AI investment, indicating that AI hardware demand will grow at over 50% through 2027, supporting key AI supply stock prices. Currently, CoWoS and HBM will remain in high demand through 2027, with no balance expected in 2028. In non-electronic themes, watch unmanned aerial vehicles and biotech medical.

In terms of valuation, Hsu Hui-chung says that industry growth stages focus on trend direction and profit upside. As of now, Taiwan’s corporate profit growth rate for 2026 has been revised upward to over 60%, and the number of stocks with upward revisions still exceeds those with downward revisions. With direction unchanged and upside increased, valuation impact remains relatively low. Key topics to watch include the MSCI weight adjustment on August 31, the new iPhone launch, and AI chip progress and specification changes.

Allianz Taiwan High-Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A-TW) manager Liao Ben-long says Taiwan’s market will benefit from Rubin mass production, new TPU launches, and capital inflows. However, valuation, rising U.S. Treasury yields, and geopolitical tensions will continue to influence market trends. Recently, capital has continued to rotate among electronics, finance, and traditional industries, allowing for repeated absorption of post‑gain valuation adjustments and clearing of positions.

Liao Ben-long points out that AI remains the most certain industry growth trend. With continued expansion in AI, high‑performance computing (HPC), and semiconductor long‑term demand, the industry growth trend has not changed. He recommends focusing on actual profit growth implementation and reasonable valuation. In this environment, active investment that flexibly adjusts industry allocation and selects competitively advantaged companies can capture market rotation opportunities while balancing growth potential and income needs.

items.title: 品牌建商在公辦都更勝出 大直「儒玉」、「藏璽」分別由皇昌及長虹拿下
items.title_en: Brand Builders Win Public Urban Renewal Projects; DaZhi "RuYu" and "CangXi" Secured by HuangChang and ChangHong
paras: 台北市住宅及都市更新中心擔任實施者的「大直儒玉」與「大直藏璽」兩大公辦都市更新案，順利完成評選，由皇昌營造(2543-TW)領銜皇昌福榮合作聯盟及長虹建設(5534-TW)分別獲選「大直儒玉」與「大直藏璽」最優申請人。

大直儒玉案最優申請人為皇昌營造領銜的皇昌福榮合作聯盟，整體建築規劃以「人本住宅、靜巷綠意、安全韌性」三大策略為核心，打造兼具宜居品質、自然綠意與安全韌性的現代住宅。預計更新後興建1幢2棟地上19層、地下4層建築，更新後樓地板面積約8779坪，結構升級為SC鋼骨造，並同步提升取得黃金級綠建築、低蘊含碳建築2級以上、耐震設計標章及國際WELL健康建築認證，另納入銀級智慧建築、建築能效1+級及新建住宅性能評估等標章與認證，預計創造逾100億元的不動產價值（未來實際規模及價值將依審議及權利變換計畫核定結果為準）。
大直儒玉案基地規劃集中留設開放空間，與鄰近公園相互串聯，形成住宅與自然環境間的綠色緩衝，並配置自行車位及友善步行動線，藉由綠廊連結周邊校園、公園及生活空間，營造兼具自然綠意、步行安全與社區共享的宜居環境。

大直藏璽案最優申請人長虹建設，整體建築規劃則以「森活共生」理念出發，打造豐富日常與提升居住品質的綠色雙塔，同時透過工法強化，築起大直安心居住防線。預計更新後興建1幢2棟地上24層、地下4層建築。更新後樓地板面積約1萬1,383坪，結構升級為SRC鋼骨鋼筋混凝土構造，進一步強化建築安全與整體性能，並升級導入黃金級綠建築及耐震設計標章，取得銀級智慧建築與建築能效1+級認證，住宅性能評估也達結構安全4級及無障礙2級，預計創造逾120億元不動產價值（未來實際規模及價值將依審議及權利變換計畫核定結果為準）。
大直藏璽案基地建物沿街側主動退縮，設置寬敞且連續的無障礙人行步道，銜接周邊學校與公園，形塑友善通學及散步綠廊，增加居民戶外交流空間；退縮範圍亦兼顧消防救災需求，有助提高災時救援效率及整體街廓防災安全。
台北市「大直儒玉」與「大直藏璽」兩大公辦都市更新案於2023年9月因鄰地基泰(2538-TW)施工不慎發生損鄰事件，經相關技師公會鑑定，兩案住家都出現牆壁裂縫、滲水、磁磚及裝修物破損等情形。考量建築物屋齡且經鄰地施工影響建築物狀態，市府隨即啟動公辦都市更新程序，於1個月內至社區召開說明會，期能透過都市更新方式改善居住環境，提升建築物使用安全。
經意願調查後，由北市府指定台北市住都中心擔任實施者，並公告更新計畫及劃定更新地區。本中心隨後積極協助住戶整合，透過駐點服務、多場座談會、建築需求調查與模擬選配，與住戶溝通凝聚共識，於去 年首次公告招商，惟未有申請人參與投標。
台北市住都中心因應市場環境變化重新檢討財務架構，並考量基地地質條件及施工風險，及持續辦理住戶溝通說明後，調整兩案招商條件，分別於今年3月及4月再次公告招商，經公開評選程序後順利決標。
paras_en: The Taipei City Residential and Urban Renewal Center, acting as the implementer, successfully completed the selection process for the two major public urban renewal projects, DaZhi RuYu and DaZhi CangXi. HuangChang Construction (2543‑TW) led the HuangChang FuRong Alliance and was chosen as the best applicant for DaZhi RuYu, while ChangHong Construction (5534‑TW) was selected for DaZhi CangXi.

The best applicant for DaZhi RuYu is the HuangChang FuRong Alliance led by HuangChang Construction. The overall building plan centers on three strategies: "human‑centric housing, quiet lane greenery, and safety resilience," creating a modern residence that balances livability, natural greenery, and safety. The project will build one two‑storey structure with 19 above‑ground floors and 4 below‑ground floors, with a post‑renewal floor area of about 8,779 ping. The structure will be upgraded to SC steel‑frame, and it will simultaneously pursue Golden‑Level Green Building, Level 2 or higher Low‑Carbon Building, seismic design certification, and international WELL Health Building certification. It will also include Silver‑Level Smart Building, Building Energy Efficiency Level 1+, and new residential performance assessment certifications, expected to create over NT$10 billion in real‑estate value (final scale and value will depend on review and rights‑transfer plan approvals).

The DaZhi RuYu site plan concentrates on retaining open space, linking with nearby parks to form a green buffer between residential and natural environments, and providing bicycle parking and pedestrian‑friendly routes. Through green corridors, it connects surrounding schools, parks, and living spaces, creating a livable environment that combines natural greenery, pedestrian safety, and community sharing.

The best applicant for DaZhi CangXi is ChangHong Construction. Its overall building plan is based on the "Forest‑Living Co‑existence" concept, creating rich daily life and improving residential quality with green twin towers. Construction methods are strengthened to build a safe residential line of defense in DaZhi. The project will build one two‑storey structure with 24 above‑ground floors and 4 below‑ground floors, with a post‑renewal floor area of about 11,383 ping. The structure will be upgraded to SRC steel‑reinforced concrete, further enhancing safety and overall performance, and will adopt Golden‑Level Green Building and seismic design certifications. It will also obtain Silver‑Level Smart Building and Building Energy Efficiency Level 1+ certifications, with residential performance assessment achieving Structural Safety Level 4 and Accessibility Level 2, expected to create over NT$12 billion in real‑estate value (final scale and value will depend on review and rights‑transfer plan approvals).

The DaZhi CangXi site builds a street‑side setback, creating a wide and continuous barrier‑free pedestrian path that connects nearby schools and parks, forming a friendly school‑to‑work and walking green corridor, increasing residents’ outdoor interaction space. The setback also considers fire and rescue needs, helping improve rescue efficiency and overall street‑level disaster safety.

In September 2023, the two public urban renewal projects, DaZhi RuYu and DaZhi CangXi, experienced neighbor damage incidents due to construction mishaps by neighboring Taiji (2538‑TW). After assessment by relevant engineering associations, residents in both projects reported wall cracks, water seepage, tile and decoration damage. Considering the building age and the impact of neighboring construction on building conditions, the city government immediately launched the public urban renewal process, holding community briefings within a month to improve living environments and enhance building safety through urban renewal.

After a willingness survey, the Taipei City government designated the Taipei City Residential and Urban Development Center as the implementer and announced the renewal plan and the designated renewal area. The center then actively assisted residents in integration, providing on‑site services, multiple forums, building needs surveys, and simulated selections, communicating with residents to build consensus. The first announcement for bidding was made last year, but no bidders participated.

The Taipei City Residential and Urban Development Center, responding to market changes, re‑examined its financial structure and considered site geology and construction risk. After continued resident communication and explanation, it adjusted the bidding conditions for both projects, re‑announcing them in March and April of this year. Through a public selection process, the projects were successfully awarded.

items.title: Vera Rubin與ASIC新品接棒放量 伺服器導軌台廠川湖及南俊下半年旺字當頭
items.title_en: Vera Rubin and ASIC New Products Drive Volume; Server Rail Makers Chuanhu and Nanjun See Strong H2 Outlook
paras: 隨著全球雲端服務供應商擴大建置AI基礎設施，伺服器導軌廠川湖(2059-TW)與南俊國際(6584-TW)在下半年伺服器出貨放量帶動下，營運持續走旺。由於次世代Vera Rubin平台與客製化晶片機櫃陸續進入出貨階段，加上先前供應鏈零組件缺料問題逐步獲得緩解，伺服器導軌產業全面迎來量價齊揚的成長週期。
產業領導廠川湖受惠AI伺服器強勁拉貨動能，上半年每股純益繳出110.96元亮麗成績。法人預期在下半年高階新品與客製化機櫃需求帶動下，川湖第三季與第四季營收皆有機會超越第二季水準。
面對龐大市場需求，川湖稼動率維持在70%至80%高檔，並提前擴產備戰，美國休士頓新廠預計9月投入量產，2027年下半年將有二廠接棒。因應未來二至三年的龐大訂單，川湖也規劃於第四季提早啟動川益三期與五期投資案，整體投資規模上看百億元。
南俊國際在經歷產品轉換期後，確立第二季為全年營運谷底，下半年在新品加入下重返升軌。為縮短新產品導入時程並搶攻市占，南俊國際採取擴增產品截面規格與強化功能專利兩大策略，在Vera Rubin世代已建立30多種規格，將與同業的進度差距縮小至一季以內。
在生產布局方面，南俊國際越南廠享有當地鋼材成本低20%至30%以及匯率結構優勢，第二季占合併營收比重已達20%，第三季可望突破30%。南俊國際採取越南優先投產策略，第四季將導入新專用產線，興建中的越南新廠預計於明年底完工，屆時整體產線規模將大幅擴充至20條。
隨著AI伺服器機櫃朝向高重量與高密度發展，滑軌的承重與公差要求更為嚴格，帶動產品單價顯著攀升。高階產品比重拉升將持續優化台廠產品組合與獲利表現。
paras_en: As global cloud service providers expand AI infrastructure, server rail manufacturers Chuanhu (2059‑TW) and Nanjun International (6584‑TW) are seeing continued strong operations in the second half, boosted by increased server shipments. The next‑generation Vera Rubin platform and customized chip cabinets are now entering the shipping stage, and earlier component shortages in the supply chain are gradually easing, ushering a growth cycle of rising volumes and prices for the server rail industry.

Industry leader Chuanhu benefits from robust AI server demand, posting an impressive earnings per share of NT$110.96 in the first half. Analysts expect that high‑end new products and customized cabinet demand in the second half could push Chuanhu’s Q3 and Q4 revenues above the Q2 level.

Facing massive market demand, Chuanhu’s utilization rate stays high at 70‑80% and it has expanded capacity early. A new plant in Houston, USA is slated for mass production in September, with a second plant coming online in the second half of 2027. To meet large orders over the next two to three years, Chuanhu plans to launch Phase 3 and Phase 5 of its Chuan‑Yi investment projects in Q4, with total investment reaching the tens of billions of NT$.

After a product transition period, Nanjun International identified Q2 as the annual low point and is rebounding in the second half with new products. To shorten new‑product introduction time and capture market share, Nanjun is expanding product cross‑section specifications and strengthening functional patents, having established over 30 specifications for the Vera Rubin generation, narrowing the gap with peers to less than a quarter‑year.

In terms of production layout, Nanjun’s Vietnam plant enjoys 20‑30% lower local steel costs and favorable exchange‑rate conditions; its share of consolidated revenue rose to 20% in Q2 and is expected to exceed 30% in Q3. Nanjun follows a Vietnam‑first production strategy and will introduce a new dedicated line in Q4; the new Vietnam factory under construction is slated for completion by the end of next year, expanding total line capacity to 20 lines.

As AI server cabinets move toward higher weight and density, slide‑rail load‑capacity and tolerance requirements become stricter, driving a notable rise in product unit prices. The increasing share of high‑end products will continue to optimize Taiwanese manufacturers’ product mix and profitability.

items.title: A記憶體價格超越一顆頂級SoC！Gartner上修2026年營收至8373億美元、占半導體市場54%
paras: 人工智慧（AI）浪潮正重新改寫半導體產業的供需結構，過去高度仰賴景氣循環、價格波動劇烈的記憶體市場，如今因高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求爆發，以及大型雲端服務商提前鎖定產能，逐漸從傳統「商品型」半導體轉變為AI基礎建設的核心環節。
Gartner 4月預估，全球記憶體營收將從2025年的2163億美元，大增至2026年的6333億美元，占整體1.32兆美元半導體市場約48%。
到了8月，Gartner進一步上修預測，預估2026年記憶體營收將達8373億美元，占整體1.56兆美元半導體市場比重更攀升至54%。
換言之，記憶體在半導體產業中的地位已大幅提升，AI帶動的HBM需求成為這波市場重估的重要推力。

AI需求爆發　科技巨頭提前多年鎖定記憶體

AI對記憶體需求的影響，不僅反映在市場預測，也直接體現在晶片業者的採購行為。
輝達(NVDA-US) 單季供應鏈與產能預付承諾，就從1190億美元大幅增加至2790億美元。該公司表示，這些承諾主要與記憶體有關，其中920億美元預計在2027會計年度剩餘期間支付，870億美元將於2028會計年度支付，另有880億美元安排在2029會計年度支付。
對記憶體製造商而言，這代表未來數年的需求能見度明顯提高。
目前市場主要由美光科技(MU-US) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 與三星電子(005930KS) 三大業者主導。
SK海力士已與約10家客戶簽訂長期協議；美光則表示，16份策略客戶協議涵蓋合約期間約20%的DRAM產能及約三分之一的NAND產能；三星也已與主要客戶達成多年期記憶體供應協議。
長約有助於記憶體業者降低需求的不確定性，但這並不代表記憶體產業已徹底擺脫景氣循環。

記憶體仍逃不過價格循環　供給增加可能再度反轉

記憶體營收高度受到價格影響，這也是投資人不能忽略的風險。
2018年，記憶體占整體半導體營收比重一度達約34%，但隔年記憶體營收便大減31.5%，其中DRAM平均售價（ASP）暴跌47.4%，記憶體占半導體產業的比重也降至26.7%。
Gartner當時將市場崩跌歸因於產能過剩及價格下滑。這代表記憶體市場即使實際需求沒有大幅萎縮，只要供給增加導致價格下跌，產業營收與獲利仍可能迅速受到衝擊。
長期供應協議確實能鎖定部分採購量，有些合約也包含價格安排，但並不能完全隔絕標準DRAM與NAND受到新產能、庫存及價格競爭的影響。
另一方面，產能擴張也正在進行。SK海力士計畫投資40億美元，在美國印第安納州興建下一代HBM封裝廠；同時，公司已核准截至2031年合計54.3兆韓元（約383億美元）的投資計畫。
技術發展則是另一項變數。SK海力士與SanDisk已推出高頻寬快閃記憶體（High Bandwidth Flash，HBF）標準，目標是緩解AI運算所面臨的記憶體瓶頸。
若相關架構進一步發展，也可能讓部分原本高度依賴HBM的AI工作負載轉向快閃記憶體。

手機記憶體成本暴增　甚至超越旗艦SoC

AI需求同樣正在影響消費電子產品的記憶體成本。
根據微博爆料帳號「數碼閒聊站」的估計，DRAM與NAND的組合成本近期大幅上升，漲幅達340%，甚至已超過部分頂級SoC的價格。
該帳號指出，去年手機廠商採用12GB RAM搭配256GB NAND時，相關成本約70美元；到了2026年第3季，同樣的12GB＋256GB組合，成本已升至約310美元。
相較之下，頂級手機SoC目前價格約280美元。也就是說，記憶體與儲存裝置的成本已成為手機物料清單中極為昂貴的項目。
若手機廠商進一步採用16GB＋256GB或16GB＋512GB等更高容量配置，成本壓力還會進一步增加，可能迫使業者調整產品定價與規格。
「數碼閒聊站」也指出，頂級SoC雖然同樣面臨價格上漲，但漲幅仍低於記憶體與儲存產品，因此SoC已退居手機最昂貴零組件的第二位。

AI讓記憶體景氣週期變長　但沒有消失

從產業結構來看，AI確實正在改變記憶體市場的運作方式。HBM的高需求，加上大型科技公司提前多年簽訂供應協議，使記憶體業者獲得過去較少見的訂單能見度。
但這並不代表記憶體已永久脫離週期性。
Gartner最新預測顯示，2026年記憶體營收占整體半導體市場比重將達54%，遠高於2025年的約27%。這項變化也強化了市場對美光、SK海力士及三星等主要記憶體業者的樂觀看法。
然而，隨著新產能逐步開出，加上HBM以外的新技術可能出現替代方案，當供給最終追上甚至超越需求時，記憶體價格仍可能重新面臨壓力。
因此，AI更可能是延長並放大記憶體景氣循環，而非徹底消滅週期。目前由AI需求推升的8373億美元記憶體市場，未來仍必須面對供給擴張後可能出現的新一輪供需平衡。

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：博通財報、8月非農就業、利率路徑線索
items.title_en: Weekly Trading Notes: Broadcom Earnings, August Non‑Farm Payrolls, Fed Rate Path Clues
paras: 這周最新的美國勞動市場數據，以及半導體大廠博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)的季度業績，將考驗近期推動美股接近歷史高點的這波漲勢。
標普500指數上周上漲，距離8月13日創下的歷史新高僅略高於1%。上周三，AI指標企業輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)公布亮眼財報，提振股市情緒。此前市場情緒曾受到美國公債殖利率上升的打擊。
投資人將關注周五(9/4)公布的美國非農就業報告，以及這份報告是否會為聯準會(Fed)未來幾個月的利率政策提供線索。
Glenmede投資策略副總裁Michael Reynolds表示，「隨著我們開始接近9月的會議，每項數據都將受到密切檢視，因為這些數據可能影響聯準會最終會採取什麼行動。」
聯準會新任主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周五發表演講後，投資人提高了對央行9月會議升息的押注，聯準會目前正努力應對高於目標的通膨。

8月非農就業報告

8月接近尾聲，標普500指數今年迄今上漲超過12%。由AI基礎設施建設大規模支出所帶動的企業獲利強勁成長，正推動美股這場持續近四年的多頭行情。
隨著美國夏季即將結束，市場整體相對平靜。「恐慌指數」VIX徘徊在今年低點附近，上周每日市場成交量也遠低於2026年的平均水準。包括就業數據在內，未來幾項事件都可能引發資產市場波動。
根據《路透社》截至上周五的調查，市場預期8月非農就業人數增加5.8萬人，失業率維持在4.1%。7月的就業報告顯示勞動市場意外轉弱，就業人數減少2.3萬人。
PNC Asset Management Group投資長Amanda Agati表示，「上一份就業報告讓市場和投資人稍微停下腳步觀望。」不過，Agati不認為勞動市場已經失速，並稱她將關注「是否確認上一份報告所顯示的趨勢，或者就業市場可能反彈至前幾個月的水準」。

Fed利率路徑成焦點

就業數據也可能透露聯準會是否有可能升息。上周公布的數據顯示，通膨仍遠高於聯準會2%的年度目標。
升息將對股市表現帶來多項挑戰，包括提高消費者與企業的借貸成本。
聯邦基金期貨上周五晚間顯示，聯準會9月會議升息的機率為57%。投資人也擔心，如果就業報告顯示就業人數大幅增加、薪資成長明顯加快，市場對升息的押注可能進一步升高。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資組合經理Matt Stucky表示，「股市希望看到的是，數據持續讓聯準會有能力維持利率不變。」
這周還將公布製造業及服務業活動等其他經濟數據。美國供應管理協會(ISM)此前公布的月度數據顯示，美國製造業活動升至四年多來最高水準。
Stucky指出，「我們認為，這股動能能否延續至9月，是非常值得關注的。」

博通壓軸 Q2財報季近尾聲

博通周三(9/2)盤後將公布財報，這家半導體公司的市值最近約為1.7兆美元，也將成為市場焦點。此前，競爭對手輝達公布的業績提振了美股指數。
輝達預期下一會計年度的營收將大幅成長70%。對於這家AI指標企業而言，這是一項罕見的財測，因為輝達通常不會公布如此長期的營收預測。
Stucky表示，「我們想知道，博通是否也能提供同樣程度的可見度。」
這周還有科技公司戴爾(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)及Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)將公布財報。
隨著大多數企業已經公布業績，根據LSEG IBES數據，標普500指數成分股第二季獲利目前預計按調整後基準計算，較去年同期成長34.5%。
Reynolds表示，本次財報季展現了「非常強勁的核心獲利能力」。「如果最後幾家公司公布的財報也持續呈現這種情況，我認為這將對今年剩餘時間的市場展望形成非常正面的支撐。」
paras_en: This week’s latest U.S. labor market data and the quarterly earnings of semiconductor giant Broadcom (AVGO‑US) will test the recent rally that has pushed the U.S. equity market close to historic highs.

The S&P 500 rose last week, remaining just over 1% below the record high set on August 13. On Wednesday, AI‑chip maker Nvidia (NVDA‑US) released stellar earnings that lifted market sentiment, after earlier dampening from rising U.S. Treasury yields.
Weekly trading notes (0831‑0904)
Investors will focus on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report released on Friday (9/4) and whether it will provide clues for the Fed’s rate policy in the coming months.

Glenmede Investment Strategy Senior Vice President Michael Reynolds said, "As we approach the September meeting, every data point will be scrutinized closely because it could influence the Fed’s final action."
After Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech last Friday, investors increased bets on a September rate hike, as the Fed works to bring inflation back to target.

August Non‑Farm Payroll Report
At the end of August, the S&P 500 has risen more than 12% this year. Strong corporate earnings driven by large‑scale AI infrastructure spending are propelling the U.S. equity rally that has lasted nearly four years.

With the U.S. summer ending, the market remains relatively calm. The VIX hovered near this year’s low, and last week’s daily trading volume was far below the 2026 average. Several upcoming events, including employment data, could trigger market volatility.

According to a Reuters poll up to last Friday, the market expects August non‑farm payrolls to rise by 58,000 jobs and unemployment to stay at 4.1%. July’s report showed an unexpected labor market slowdown, with jobs falling by 23,000.

PNC Asset Management Group CIO Amanda Agati said, "The last employment report made the market and investors pause to observe." However, Agati does not believe the labor market has stalled and said she will watch whether the trend shown in the last report is confirmed or if the job market rebounds to previous levels.

Fed Rate Path Focus
Employment data may also reveal whether the Fed is likely to raise rates. Last week’s data showed inflation still far above the Fed’s 2% annual target.
Rate hikes will pose several challenges to the stock market, including higher borrowing costs for consumers and businesses.

Fed futures last Friday evening indicated a 57% probability of a September rate hike. Investors also worry that if the employment report shows a large increase in jobs and a clear acceleration in wage growth, bets on a rate hike could rise further.
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management portfolio manager Matt Stucky said, "The market wants to see data that continues to give the Fed the ability to keep rates unchanged."

Other economic data, such as manufacturing and services activity, will also be released this week. The Institute for Supply Management’s (ISM) latest monthly data showed U.S. manufacturing activity at its highest level in more than four years.
Stucky noted, "We believe it is worth watching whether this momentum can carry through to September."

Broadcom’s Q2 Earnings Close to the End of the Quarter
